## ap_interdimensional_processing_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aap_interdimensional_processing_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果只限制在三维空间中，我们的运算潜力将十分有限。将网络延伸至虚空彼端，我们还大有可得。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:7`

### English

Our calculation potential is limited when constrained only to the three physical dimensions. There is more to be gained by reaching our network into the spaces beyond the void.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:10`

## shroud.7099.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.7099.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的思绪带着全新的目的在§H虚境§!中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。\n\n尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:14`

### English

Our thoughts move through the §HShroud§! with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.\n\nThough hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the answers we give will influence the future of our society.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:20`

## shroud.7100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.7100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与§H虚境§!的连结稳固；时刻准备着受到召唤。一段有节奏的乐句传信而来，这是虚境在对我们歌唱。\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:19`

### English

Our link to the §HShroud§! is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:26`

## shroud.7120.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.7120.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:85`

### English

The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:108`

## shroud.7120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.7120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.7120.desc.common$\n\n我们已升华的心灵正蓄势待发，准备迎接进一步的转化。那些用于承载心灵所需的物质载体，其重要性将大幅降低。\n\n若我们继续沿着这条道路前行，人口将能超越对物质事务的关注，全身心地将部分存在投入到虚境之中。相比于精神敏锐度的提升，体力劳动能力的下降只是微不足道的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:86`

### English

$shroud.7120.desc.common$\n\nOur ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.\n\nIf we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:109`

## shroud.7121.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.7121.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.7120.desc.common$\n\n在这个物质维度中，我们升华后的形态蕴藏着巨大潜能。源源不断注入的灵能不断增强着我们的力量，并能将这股力量进一步传导至整个社会。\n\n我们不仅会吟诵虚境的乐章，更会将其引入我们的[GetGovBehaviourLoc]之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:93`

### English

$shroud.7120.desc.common$\n\nOur ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.\n\nWe would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our [GetGovBehaviourLoc].

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:116`

## auth_shroud_democratic_transcendent_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_shroud_democratic_transcendent_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

所有的超然意识在虚境中天然平等，而选举则保障了肉身世界的平等。通过灵能投票，公民选举代表进入执政秘会，通过心灵感应冥想寻求共识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:100`

### English

All transcended minds are of equal status in the Shroud, while elections ensure equality in the corporeal realm. Voting by psionic ballot, citizens elect their representatives to the governing conclave which seeks consensus through telepathic contemplation.

## shroud.5055.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5055.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

我们被骗了。\n\n我们的情报人员截获了来自§H[from.GetName]§!的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。\n\n他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:252`

### English

We were fooled.\n\nOur intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the §H[from.GetName]§!. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.\n\nThey have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:309`

## shroud.5055.desc.galactic

$shroud.5055.desc.common$他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:253`

### English

$shroud.5055.desc.common$ News of their duplicity has spread rapidly, adversely affecting the reputation of the [from.GetName] throughout the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:310`

### 中文

虽然我们成功挑起了冲突，但行动并未完全按照计划进行。我们的一个特工的通讯被截获，导致我们暗中的行动被所有相关方知晓。\n\n我们试图辩解，但毫无用处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:255`

### English

Though we managed to incite a conflict, the operation did not go entirely to plan. One of our agents' communications was intercepted, revealing our covert actions to all parties involved.\n\nOur attempts to explain away the affair were ineffective.

## TUTORIAL_SHROUD_TAB_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATUTORIAL_SHROUD_TAB_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这里是§S虚境§!选项卡。左侧的面板展示了帝国在虚境中的位置，由归属于四个被称为§S超主§!的灵能实体的§S灵域§!所代表。\n\n我们当前的位置由§S$concept_attunement$§!决定，可凭借在物质领域中的活动而获得某位超主的青睐获得。累积$concept_attunement$能够揭示超主的身份。一旦超主身份被揭示，即可点击超主的灵域打开这位超主的面板。\n\n点击§S$DELVE$§!或左侧面板的中央即可进入虚境并探索灵能界。在探索过程中，领域内我们的$concept_attunement$位置可能影响发现结果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:305`

### English

This is the §SShroud§! tab. The left panel visualizes our empire's position in the Shroud, represented by the §Sdomains§! of four psionic entities known as §SPatrons§!.\n\nOur position is determined by §S$concept_attunement$§!, which is gained when an action in the physical realm finds favor with a Patron. Gain $concept_attunement$ to begin the process of revealing a Patron's identity. Once revealed, click a Patron's domain to open the Patron panel.\n\nClick §S$DELVE$§! or the center of the left panel to enter the Shroud and explore the psionic realm. While exploring, what we discover may be influenced by our $concept_attunement$ position within the domains.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:376`

## TUTORIAL_SHROUD_PATRON_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATUTORIAL_SHROUD_PATRON_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§S超主§!面板展示了与虚境超主相关的信息与选项。完成§S$concept_callings$§!和§S$concept_deeds$§!即可提升对应超主的§S$concept_attunement$§!。\n\n提升$concept_attunement$可以解锁§S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!，为帝国带来增益。当$concept_attunement$提升到一定程度后即可启动签订§S契约§!的流程，这会进一步获得更多强力效果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:307`

### English

The §SPatron§! panel provides information and options relating to a Shroud Patron. Complete the objectives provided by §S$concept_callings$§! and §S$concept_deeds$§! to gain §S$concept_attunement$§! with this particular entity.\n\nIncrease $concept_attunement$ to unlock §S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!, which provide advantages for our empire. Gain significant $concept_attunement$ to a Patron to begin the process of forming a §SCovenant§!, which will yield even more substantial effects.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:379`

## tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atutorial.shroud_covenant.shared&lang=en)

## tutorial.2600.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atutorial.2600.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有灵能人口定居的殖民地能够散发§S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!。光环来源于我们当前§S$concept_attunement$§!最高的§S虚境超主§!。\n\n$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$在为帝国提供多种多样的修正效果的同时，也能对友好或者敌对国家施加影响。我们如果想要扩大光环的范围，就需要通过与超主进一步调和来解锁£research£§S$tech_aura_intensification$§!科技。\n\n打开§S虚境§!选项卡或者将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的的光环图标上均可以查看$PSIONIC_AURA$的效果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:314`

### English

Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!. This Aura is drawn from the §SShroud Patron§! with which we currently have the highest §S$concept_attunement$§!.\n\n$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £research£ §S$tech_aura_intensification$§! technology.\n\nTo observe the effects of our $PSIONIC_AURA$, open the §SShroud§! tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:389`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:315`

### English

Tutorial: $tech_aura_intensification$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:391`

## tutorial.2610.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atutorial.2610.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!能够提高§S强度§!并向外扩散到其他恒星系。\n\n$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$有三个强度等级，分别产生不同的效果。$PSIONIC_AURA$在提升强度等级或强度提升至最大值时，会试着向临近恒星系扩散。大多数$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的扩散距离有上限。‘\n\n有多种途径能够增强光环，例如繁衍更多$trait_psionic$人口、提升£happiness£§S幸福度§!、增加£job_telepath£[GetTelepathCap]岗位数量，以及在£sector£星域中雇佣具有灵能能力的总督或者£leader£领袖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:316`

### English

Our §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§! now has the ability to gain §SIntensity§! and spread into other systems.\n\n$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a $PSIONIC_AURA$ reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have a maximum range they can spread from their source.\n\nAura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high $trait_psionic$ populations, £happiness£ §SHappiness§! levels, £job_telepath£ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £leader£ Leaders of £sector£ Sectors.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:392`

## tutorial.2620.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atutorial.2620.name&lang=en)

### 中文

教程：光环冲突

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:317`

### English

Tutorial: Aura Clashing

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:394`

## tutorial.2620.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atutorial.2620.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!可能会与另一个扩散到相邻星系的光环发生冲突。一旦出现这种情况，这两个光环就会相互对抗，并决出最终由哪个光环来实控该恒星系。\n\n对抗的结果取决于双方光环每月§S强度§!增长，可以将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的光环图标来查看这一过程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:318`

### English

Our §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§! has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.\n\nThis process depends on the monthly §SIntensity§! gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:395`

## tech_psionic_lightning_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atech_psionic_lightning_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过暂时在舰船之间建立灵能链接，可以直接释放一波心灵能量造成毁灭性影响。这种原始能量能够扰乱舰船系统，影响其中船员的思想。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:345`

### English

By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:429`

这种高浓度$zro_lower$弹丸可以在多重现实之间相移，从而不受干扰地透过敌军护盾。一旦与实物接触，其破坏效果将呈指数级增长。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_lifecrypt_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些巨大的装置能从附近的特定人群中抽提多余的能量。这些指定个体穿着专门的设备，将生命力输送到中央管道中，再分配给地位更高的人。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_lifecrypt_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个名字可能让人产生误解，但灵魂虹吸装置确实是基于实用科学的。它们经过特殊校准，通过身体系绳从个体身上抽提能量，能在不危及生命的情况下抽调生物体的大量新陈代谢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:467`

### English

While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, they are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from organisms without endangering their lives.

## shroud.5012.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5012.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的怀疑得到了确认。[first_neighbor.GetAdjective]与[second_neighbor.GetAdjective]的文明证实，他们在正式进行外交之前，曾通过非正式渠道开展过联系。\n\n这些§H派系§!如今从我们的阴影中现身，承认了他们的存在。它们被称为§H$pft_the_curtain$§!、§H$pft_the_masquerade$§!以及§H$pft_the_grand_dance$§!。这群曾经的秘密组织如今正公开请求与我们展开正式对话。\n\n至于它们想要什么，以及它们是如何知晓所知之事，我们也许永远无法真正知道。但为了我们的最佳利益，也许我们应当遵循他们的命令行事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:632`

### English

Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.\n\nThese §HFactions§! now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as §H$pft_the_curtain$§!, §H$pft_the_masquerade$§! and §H$pft_the_grand_dance$§!, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.\n\nWhat they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:806`

## shroud.5013.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5013.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。\n\n尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的§H派系§!的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。\n\n也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:636`

### English

There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.\n\nDespite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret §HFactions§! that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.\n\nPerhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:811`

### English

## shroud.5105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。\n\n[This.GetTheChosenP2]\n\n在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。\n\n我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:655`

### English

We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.\n\n[This.GetTheChosenP2]\n\nFor as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.\n\nBy what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:836`

## shroud.5105.desc_p2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5105.desc_p2&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以在思绪的最深处感受到祂的存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的脑中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:656`

### English

We feel its presence in our deepest thoughts. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:837`

## shroud.5105.desc_p2_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5105.desc_p2_machine&lang=en)

我们在最复杂演算中检测到其存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的电路中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:657`

### English

We detect its presence in our most complex calculations. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our circuits.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:838`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:663`

### English

Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the §H[GetChosenPatron]§! has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.\n\nIt lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:845`

## shroud.5115.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5115.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。\n\n虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。\n\n在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。§H[GetChosenPatron]§!正等待着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:670`

### English

The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.\n\nThough we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.\n\nOn the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The §H[GetChosenPatron]§! awaits us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:853`

## civic_tankbound_desc

### 中文

该社会的成员在专门的生物溶液罐中度过一生。因此他们严重依赖辅助设备，无法直接从事体力劳动。

## shroud.500.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.500.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1151`

### English

Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was once thought to be fringe science.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1437`

## shroud.507.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.507.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[mining_planet.GetName]§!上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。\n\n经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1156`

### English

A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1443`

## shroud.512.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.512.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在例行土地探察时意外地发现了§H[This.GetName]§!上大片土地的土壤质量近年来急剧提高。\n\n我们相信许多此前认为不适合耕种的土地现在可以用来扩张农业活动了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1161`

### English

A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on §H[This.GetName]§! has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.\n\nWe believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1449`

## shroud.512.desc_anglers

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.512.desc_anglers&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘渔船在§H[This.GetName]§!的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1162`

### English

A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of §H[This.GetName]§!. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1450`

## shroud.517.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.517.title&lang=en)

### 中文

地热喷口

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1164`

### English

Geothermal Vents

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1453`

## shroud.517.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.517.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一场§H[This.GetName]§!上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。\n\n该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1165`

### English

Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on §H[This.GetName]§!. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.\n\nThis natural phenomenon provides us with an opportunity to expand the colony's energy infrastructure with new geothermal power plants and heat pumps.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1454`

## shroud.522.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.522.title&lang=en)

### 中文

发现量子流

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1167`

### English

Quantum Particle Stream Discovered

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1457`

## shroud.522.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.522.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在§H[physics_planet.GetName]§!附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。\n\n对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1168`

### English

An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near §H[physics_planet.GetName]§!. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.\n\nFocused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1458`

## shroud.527.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.527.title&lang=en)

### 中文

发现跨次元回声

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1170`

### English

Interdimensional Echo Discovered

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1461`

## shroud.527.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.527.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[From.GetResearchers]在§H[society_planet.GetName]§!系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。\n\n初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。\n\n如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1171`

### English

Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near §H[society_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nInitial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.\n\nIf we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1462`

## shroud.532.title

发现先进残骸

### English

Advanced Wreckage Discovered

## shroud.532.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.532.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]\n\n我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1174`

### English

A derelict ship has appeared in §H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]\n\nWe have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1466`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1175`

### English

The irreparably damaged vessel was able to generate some form of invisibility field and is generally far more tactically advanced than our own fleets.

## shroud.537.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.537.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[mining_planet.GetName]§!的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。\n\n该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1180`

### English

Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.\n\nThis geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1473`

## shroud.543.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.543.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。\n\n在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1183`

### English

A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the §H[From.GetName]§! system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.\n\nAfter an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1477`

## shroud.545.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.545.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种难以言喻的乐观主义席卷了[This.GetAdjective]各星。大众们对自己的生活感到更加满足、舒适和惬意。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象吉兆引起，而且对§H[This.GetName]§!而言必须是一个好兆头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1190`

### English

An inexplicable air of optimism is washing throughout [This.GetAdjective] worlds. The population is that bit more content, comfortable, and satisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments, and can only be a good omen for the future of the §H[This.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1485`

## shroud.545.desc_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.545.desc_gestalt&lang=en)

§H[This.GetName]§!正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1191`

### English

The §H[This.GetName]§! is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1486`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1195`

### English

Three celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a favorable trine; §H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§! and §H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThis beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of tranquility and harmony to our colony on §H[This.GetName]§!.

## shroud.570.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.570.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的两位内阁成员，§H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§!和§H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§!发现他们的占星结果高度互补。\n\n因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。

### English

Previously unnoticed, it contained a wide variety of interesting artifacts we can add to our collection.

## shroud.707.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.707.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致§H[This.GetName]§!的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。\n\n[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1224`

### English

A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the §H[This.GetName]§! in §H[This.System.GetName]§!.\n\n[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible for this error have been disciplined appropriately.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1527`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1230`

### English

## shroud.710.desc_starbase

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.710.desc_starbase&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§!中[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation]的恒星基地上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。\n\n$shroud.710.desc$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1231`

### English

An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on the [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation] of §H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.\n\n$shroud.710.desc$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1535`

## shroud.710.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.710.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1232`

### English

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1536`

## shroud.715.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.715.title&lang=en)

### 中文

外交失言

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1238`

### English

Diplomatic Faux Pas

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1543`

## shroud.715.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.715.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。\n\n虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1239`

### English

One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vitriolic and hateful insults to the [diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]. The unfortunate incident has been spread across the galactic media and disparaged our reputation.\n\nWhile these actions do not warrant immediate dismissal, our standing within the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has been weakened as a result of this indiscretion.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1544`

## shroud.715.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.715.a&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1240`

### English

An unfortunate mistake.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1545`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1241`

### English

## shroud.720.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.720.title&lang=en)

### 中文

极端恒星耀斑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1243`

### English

Extreme Solar Flare

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1549`

## shroud.720.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.720.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§!发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。\n\n这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1244`

### English

An unprecedented solar flare from §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.\n\nThis aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial body. Our analysis of the star's coronal layer shows that its predicted lifespan has been reduced by over three million years.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1550`

## shroud.720.desc_storm

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.720.desc_storm&lang=en)

### 中文

释放出的能量还在该恒星系中引发了一场$celestial_storm$。目前已经采取紧急应对措施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1245`

### English

The resulting discharge of energy has triggered a $celestial_storm$ in the system. Emergency measures are currently underway.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1551`

## shroud.720.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.720.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§!内所有的$observation_station$、$research_station$以及$mining_station$都被摧毁了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1246`

### English

Every $observation_station$, $research_station$ and $mining_station$ in §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1552`

## shroud.725.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.title&lang=en)

### 中文

高规格交通事故

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1248`

### English

High Profile Traffic Accident

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1555`

## shroud.725.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1249`

### English

Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1556`

## shroud.725.desc_killed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.desc_killed&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.725.desc$\n\n尽管我们的应急措施响应及时，[This.GetHisHer]的伤还是太重了，不治身亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1250`

### English

$shroud.725.desc$\n\nDespite the swift response of our emergency services, [This.GetHisHer] injuries ultimately proved fatal.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1557`

## shroud.725.desc_killed_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.desc_killed_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.725.desc$\n\n不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1251`

### English

$shroud.725.desc$\n\nUnfortunately, their systems were damaged beyond repair.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1558`

## shroud.725.desc_maimed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.desc_maimed&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.725.desc$\n\n[This.GetName]虽然得以幸存，但也受了不可逆损伤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1252`

### English

$shroud.725.desc$\n\n[This.GetName] survived the collision, but not unscathed. The damage done is irreversible.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1559`

## shroud.725.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.725.a&lang=en)

太悲惨了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1253`

### English

How tragic.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1560`

## shroud.730.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.730.title&lang=en)

### 中文

巨大陷坑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1255`

### English

Massive Sinkholes

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1563`

## shroud.730.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.730.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[This.GetName]§!地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。\n\n我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1256`

### English

Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.\n\nWe cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1564`

## shroud.730.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.730.a&lang=en)

### 中文

此星当谴……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1257`

### English

Curse the stars...

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1565`

## shroud.730.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.730.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

有一栋建筑成为了废墟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1258`

### English

A building now lies in ruins.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1566`

## shroud.735.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.735.title&lang=en)

### 中文

自发骚乱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1260`

### English

Spontaneous Uproar

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1569`

## shroud.735.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.735.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[This.GetName]§!上四处爆发了危险的骚乱。一种关于[From.GetAdjective]政府操纵天象的无端阴谋论激起了强烈的民愤。狂热示威很快演变成暴力冲突，煽动者在殖民地各处大肆破坏。\n\n暴力游行很快被安全部队镇压，但对我们基础设施的损伤仍需要时间来修复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1261`

### English

Dangerous riots have erupted across §H[This.GetName]§!. The population is fueled with fervor in protest of an unsubstantiated conspiracy about the [From.GetAdjective] government's control of celestial alignments. What began as a zealous demonstration soon devolved into violence, with agitators causing mass destruction throughout the colony.\n\nThe violent demonstrators were neutralized by security forces, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1570`

## shroud.735.desc_hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.735.desc_hive&lang=en)

### 中文

一大群反常的子个体在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1262`

### English

A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1571`

## shroud.735.desc_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.735.desc_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[This.GetName]§!上有一小群无人机感染了一种神秘的病毒，开始反抗并试图摧毁殖民地。尽管他们非常疯狂，防御部队还是将这些故障单元迅速解决，但我们基础设施受到的损伤仍需要时间来修复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1263`

### English

A significant minority of the drones on §H[This.GetName]§! were infected by a mysterious virus, causing them to rebel and attempt to destroy the colony. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the malfunctioning units, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1572`

## shroud.735.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.735.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会重建的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1264`

### English

We will rebuild.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1573`

## shroud.740.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.740.title&lang=en)

### 中文

传染病突然爆发

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1266`

### English

Sudden Infectious Disease

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1576`

## shroud.740.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.740.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[This.GetName]§!上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1267`

### English

A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1577`

## shroud.745.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.745.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§!和§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!。\n\n这种灾难性天象在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1270`

### English

Four celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§! and §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!.\n\nThis disastrous astrological phenomenon will sow the seeds of doubt on the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, encouraging [FromFrom.GetDissent] by sowing disharmony among the population.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1581`

## shroud.750.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.750.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§!上的居民发现§H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§!正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1274`

### English

Inhabitants of §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§! have observed that §H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§! is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1586`

## shroud.755.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.755.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。\n\n尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1277`

### English

Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.\n\nAttempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access a metaphysical meditative environment, impeding their development.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1590`

## shroud.770.desc_default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.770.desc_default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们一位地方官员对其他帝国的个人观点意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一名通信人员忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1288`

### English

One of our regional administrators' personal opinions about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications operative forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1604`

## shroud.1105.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.1105.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从§H[root.GetName]§!上的一座设施内逃了出来。\n\n这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1317`

### English

A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on §H[root.GetName]§! via a makeshift escape tunnel.\n\nFashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many knew of its existence, and how it remained undetected for so long.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1637`

## shroud.1105.desc.escaped

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.1105.desc.escaped&lang=en)

### 中文

此类事件一再发生，需要对此做出坚决的应对以防止类似事件重演。我们此前在这一问题上的仁慈，反倒似乎成了对于剩余个体的鼓励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1318`

### English

Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses. Our previous leniency on this issue seems to have served as encouragement to the remaining population.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1638`

### 中文

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]\n\n这种信息可以有多种形式：具体的语言或视觉材料、宽泛的概念或广义的情绪感知。关键在于，精心策划的传输过程可以让受众在毫无感觉的情况下完成这个流程。\n\n[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro]

Crucially, a carefully performed transmission leaves its subject completely unaware of the procedure.\n\n[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro].

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1660`

## shroud.2300.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2300.intro&lang=en)

§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们可以向易感意识传输认知信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1338`

### English

Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness.

## shroud.2305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的许多[Owner.GetCitizenPlural]在§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!各地看到了怪异的幻影。这些幻象大多数情况下都是偶发的，不会重复，但有一个地方因频繁出现而引起了注意。[Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]\n\n人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1349`

### English

A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]\n\nIt has been discovered that the phantom appears near the mouth of a mineral-rich cavern system.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1673`

## shroud.2310.name

### English

Psionic Parasites

## shroud.2310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。\n\n随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。\n\n[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1359`

### English

An unpredicted climatic event occurred on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! - a storm-like disturbance that swept through an area with particularly elevated levels of psionic energy. In its wake, we found some of the local fauna infected with a strange parasite that burrows into and slowly consumes the cerebral organ.\n\nAs this parasitic infection progresses, the host animals temporarily develop basic telekinetic abilities which they then use for hunting and feeding before they inevitably expire.\n\n[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1684`

## shroud.2310.ending_biological

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2310.ending_biological&lang=en)

### 中文

有趣的是，这些寄生虫在仔细处理后是可以安全食用的。它富含多种营养，可以为公民提供物美价廉的食物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1360`

### English

Interestingly, these parasites are safely edible after careful processing. As rich sources of various nutrients, they might provide a healthy, inexpensive foodstuff for our citizens.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1685`

## shroud.2310.ending_lithoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2310.ending_lithoid&lang=en)

### 中文

有趣的是，这些生物分泌大量富含有机化合物的物质，因此或能提供矿物合成的新方法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1361`

### English

Interestingly, these creatures secrete high volumes of a substance rich in inorganic compounds. They might therefore provide a novel method of mineral synthesis.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1686`

## shroud.2310.ending_machine

## shroud.2315.name

### English

Material Manifestations

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1694`

## shroud.2315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。\n\n所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1369`

### English

While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.\n\nThe psychic toll involved is significant, but it is possible we could direct these efforts into manifesting objects to fit our purposes. Where these objects come from and what consequences may result are unknown.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1695`

## shroud.2320.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2320.name&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能二重身

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1374`

### English

Psionic Doubling

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1701`

## shroud.2320.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2320.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]\n\n目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1375`

### English

Rumors had spread of psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] capable of bilocation, the ability to be physically present in two different locations at the same time. We dispatched [Owner.GetResearchers] to investigate these improbable claims; astonishingly, they have proven to be true.[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]\n\nPresently, only a fraction of our population possesses this remarkable skill, but further study might yield methods of training others.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1702`

## shroud.2320.extra

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2320.extra&lang=en)

### 中文

\n\n物理距离似乎不是障碍。专家们反复验证了这些人他们可以同时在两个不同的星系中短暂地出现

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1376`

### English

\n\nPhysical distance seems to be no impediment, as these adepts have repeatedly shown that they can briefly locate themselves in two different star systems at once

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1703`

### English

## shroud.2325.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2325.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。\n\n如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，§H[Owner.GetName]§!就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1386`

### English

A wondrous psionic faculty has emerged in a small proportion of the [Owner.GetAdjective] population: telesthesia, the ability to sense entities from distances beyond the ordinary range of perception. Without any kind of specialized training, these remote viewers can accurately describe distant objects in remarkable detail.\n\nThe §H[Owner.GetName]§! stands to reap significant rewards if these powers can be controlled and strengthened. By drawing on the abilities of our most powerful [Owner.GetTelepathPlural], we can try to hone this technique and focus it on an important enterprise.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1714`

## shroud.2400.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2400.name&lang=en)

### 中文

物质流失

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1394`

### English

Matter in Flux

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1723`

## shroud.2400.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2400.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。\n\n为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1395`

### English

We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected locations.\n\nWe could respond by halting psionic activity in the vicinity of material stores, but this will slow the pace of our psionic research and limit its industrial applications. Alternatively, we could follow proposals to develop a psionic field attenuator that should halt the dematerialization process. If we do nothing, our psionic research capabilities will be attenuated.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1724`

### 中文

死人头

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1402`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1732`

## shroud.2405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。\n\n参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。\n\n创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDeceasedAdj]人口的滥用引发了伦理问题。此外还有报告称，越来越多的盗尸者通过犯罪手段来获取这些器官。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1403`

### English

Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.\n\nPractitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Owner.GetDeathName], an idea originating in scientific theories about psychic forces being a form of energy - convertible but indestructible. A small but growing percentage also believe that the passing of a psionic [Owner.GetIndividualName] creates an infinitesimal subspace rupture, a window through which to glimpse other dimensions.\n\nWhile innovative research is commendable, interference with parts of our [Owner.GetDeceasedAdj] population raises ethical concerns. Furthermore, we have received reports about a growing class of body snatchers who procure these parts by criminal means.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1733`

## shroud.2410.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2410.name&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能变形

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1408`

### English

Psionic Transformations

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1739`

## shroud.2410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。\n\n尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1409`

### English

Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psionic activities can cause physical changes to the practitioner. While we cannot prevent the emergence of these protuberances, we have discovered that the rate of their growth can be controlled psionically.\n\nThough initially causing some [Owner.GetDistressName], these extra parts have proven surprisingly useful. If applied productively, their utility might compensate for their added cognitive load.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1740`

## shroud.2415.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2415.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。\n\n尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌握灵能的过程中，最好还是谨慎推进为好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1415`

### English

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.\n\nWhile the industrial applications are promising, the social implications remain an open question. If a small group of skilled psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] can power and operate a network of complex machinery, legions of [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] are at risk of redundancy. [Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra] While our mastery of psionics is still developing, it may be best to proceed with caution.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1747`

## shroud.2420.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2420.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对§H[Owner.GetName]§!造成了广泛的破坏。\n\n一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1423`

### English

A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the §H[Owner.GetName]§!.\n\nA small number of particularly powerful psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are among the worst affected, and preliminary statistical analysis suggests a correlation between psionic aptitude and intensity of symptoms.[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1756`

## shroud.2502.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2502.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到报道称，§H[This.GetName]§!的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。\n\n大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。\n\n虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1451`

### English

We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on §H[This.GetName]§!.\n\nThe atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfall.' Significant psychic disturbances are being reported throughout the immediate vicinity.\n\nThe conditions within the shroudfall are extremely [This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]. Unless we invest in restoring the environment, the inhabitants will have to adapt to radically altered circumstances.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1786`

## shroud.2505.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2505.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。\n\n受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1460`

### English

Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].\n\nThose affected claim to be doing the bidding of a nameless entity that dwells in the peripheries of their consciousness, guiding their every action. As we continue to forge our psionic future, we must carefully consider the impact of extradimensional forces on [Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche].

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1796`

## shroud.2510.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2510.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]\n\n更广泛的测试表明，有很大一部分人口也[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra]，其原因可能是[Owner.GetPsychicAdj]活动的增多。不受控灵能活动突然爆发的能量可能导致迅速的恶化和严重后果。\n\n高级冥想技术也许有助于不借助[Owner.GetMedicalAdj]介入来控制这种灵能活动，但我们的一些[Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议需要研发[Owner.GetMedicalImplantName]来解决这种问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1470`

### English

[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]\n\nWider testing has revealed that a significant proportion of our population is suffering from [Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra], likely due to increased [Owner.GetPsychicAdj] activity. The sudden bursts of energy released through uncontrolled psionic activity can lead to rapid escalation and grave outcomes.\n\nAdvanced meditation techniques might help to control this psionic activity without [Owner.GetMedicalAdj] intervention, but some of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] advise that we develop a [Owner.GetMedicalImplantName] to cope with the problem.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1807`

## shroud.2515.extra_default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2515.extra_default&lang=en)

### 中文

人人都在做噩梦，休眠循环变成了麻木的不安。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，直击每个人最原始的恐惧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1485`

### English

Bad dreams are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of unquiet stupor. Sufferers recall visions of terrifying, otherworldly strangeness that express their most primal fears.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1823`

## shroud.2515.extra_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2515.extra_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1486`

### English

We have begun experiencing what we think singular consciousnesses call 'dreams.' Sufferers of this phenomenon report visions of otherworldly strangeness that represent fundamental threats to our collective.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1824`

## shroud.2520.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2520.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。\n\n通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和§H虚境§!之间的微小穿孔出现在了§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1496`

### English

§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.\n\nAttempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited effect. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have established that a miniscule breach between our reality and the §HShroud§! occurred at a single location on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, causing an inflow of psionic energy that transformed the once-harmless beasts into violent predators. To tackle the threat, this might be the best place to focus our energies.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1835`

## shroud.2600.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2600.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。\n\n那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1505`

### English

The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.\n\nThose with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privileges. Their divisive rhetoric is increasingly aggressive and threatens to turn violent.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1845`

## shroud.2605.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2605.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。\n\n如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1514`

### English

A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.\n\nIf their activities are allowed to continue, it could threaten progress in understanding and mastering our emergent psionic powers.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1855`

## shroud.2610.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2610.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着灵能能力日益增强，我们的人口中出现了越来越多的滥用、欺骗和狡诈的行为。一小撮[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很明显在用有问题的方式使用新获得的力量。\n\n愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1523`

### English

As our psionic abilities grow stronger, we have seen an increase in reports of exploitation, trickery, and fraudulent behavior among our population. A small but sizable minority of [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly applying their newfound powers in questionable ways.\n\nOutraged victims are now demanding an overhaul of existing laws to provide stronger protections against psionic crime.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1865`

## shroud.2615.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2615.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的人口在逐渐适应新力量的过程中，有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始尝试冒极大的风险来加速灵能发展。\n\n黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1532`

### English

As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.\n\nThe use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unregulated [owner.GetMedicalFacility] are offering a range of unproven services to help individuals maximize their psionic capacities. The consequences of such risk-taking are difficult to predict.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1875`

## shroud.2620.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2620.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。\n\n尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1541`

### English

A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].\n\nAlthough these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the collective, their unexplained physical behavior has raised troubling questions about the future consequences of our growing psionic powers.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1885`

## shroud.2621.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2621.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。\n\n据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1550`

### English

A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.\n\nThose without psionic powers who visit these areas have been reportedly returning physically unharmed but mentally disturbed in ways they struggle to explain.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1895`

## shroud.2625.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2625.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。\n\n这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。\n\n$shroud.2625.desc_common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1560`

### English

A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.\n\nThe outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in many cases, proving fatal.\n\n$shroud.2625.desc_common$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1906`

## shroud.2626.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2626.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。\n\n奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。\n\n$shroud.2625.desc_common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1571`

### English

A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.\n\nCuriously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affected. In most cases, the failure is not just disruptive, but destructive.\n\n$shroud.2625.desc_common$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1918`

## shroud.2635.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2635.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。\n\n很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1591`

### English

The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.\n\nIt is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other consciousnesses than before. Whether these changes represent a new strength or weakness for the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1940`

## shroud.2635.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2635.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们的人口正在探索新的灵能能力，一个新的社群建立了起来，旨在将其用于对其他意识更广泛的共情理解。\n\n该集体声称，由于新出现的灵能感知力，他们能够高度复杂地模拟其他人的观点、思维模式和情感。他们的这种活动对[owner.GetName]究竟是好是坏仍有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1592`

### English

As our population explores their newfound psionic capacities, a new community has been established with the goal of applying them towards greater empathetic understanding of other consciousnesses.\n\nThis collective professes to be capable of highly sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other minds thanks to their emergent psionic senses. Whether their activities will ultimately benefit or undermine the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1941`

As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from

## shroud.2640.desc.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2640.desc.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1604`

### English

Our studies suggest the instability is not a flaw, but rather due to the exceptional psionic efficiency present in the afflicted [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the right training, these [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] could be the next step in our psionic evolution. Any attempts to harness these new abilities will not come without inherent risk.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1954`

## shroud.2640.desc.gestalt
