## shroud.2750.desc_p1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p1&lang=en)

### 中文

自古以来就有很多能力非凡的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵别人的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1619`

### English

Since time immemorial, tales have flourished of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading other minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1970`

## shroud.2750.desc_p1_hive_mind

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p1_hive_mind&lang=en)

### 中文

在反常还是正常的古时候，有很多拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵集体外的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1620`

### English

In former days, when deviancy was rife, stories were told of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading minds external to the collective, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1971`

## shroud.2750.desc_p1_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p1_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1621`

### English

From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other improbable functions.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1972`

## shroud.2750.desc_p1_unplugged

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p1_unplugged&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们的历史短暂而暴力，我们[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的想象力也偶尔会天马行空，产生关于拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的故事：读心、用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1622`

### English

Despite the short and violent history of our civilization, we [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, telling tales of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1973`

## shroud.2750.desc_p2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p2&lang=en)

### 中文

如今，我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]已经得到了确切的证据，部分[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确实具有这种精神力量。然而，依旧只有一小部分[This.GetSpeciesWord]显示出了这种“灵能”之力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1623`

### English

Now, our [This.GetScientistPlural] have obtained conclusive proof that certain [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are truly capable of such acts of the mind. As of yet, only a small minority of our [This.GetSpeciesWord] has manifested these 'psionic' powers.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1974`

## shroud.2750.desc_p2_unplugged

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p2_unplugged&lang=en)

### 中文

许多人相信我们其实是将这些异想天开的故事从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]组装我们之前的时代继承下来的，只有少数人真的相信。$shroud.2750.desc_p2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1624`

### English

Many believe we have carried these fantastical stories since before we were assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], though few considered them credible. $shroud.2750.desc_p2$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1975`

[This.GetMindOverMatterEnding]

### English

[This.GetMindOverMatterEnding]

## shroud.2750.desc_p3_default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p3_default&lang=en)

### 中文

这种力量似乎是解放我们全部力量的钥匙。如果[This.GetAdjective]的整个社会可以解锁这些潜在能力，我们就能开始掌控超出常人理解的维度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1626`

### English

This power seems key to achieving our fullest potential. If these latent abilities can be unlocked throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can begin to master dimensions beyond ordinary comprehension.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1977`

## shroud.2750.desc_p3_crisis_4_5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p3_crisis_4_5&lang=en)

我们已经充满了从§H虚境§!而来的灵能能量。如果我们可以在整个[This.GetAdjective]社会规模上解锁灵能之力，就能完全获得我们应得的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1627`

### English

We are already being fueled by psionic energy drawn from the §HShroud§!. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our destined potential.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1978`

## shroud.2750.desc_p3_origins

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2750.desc_p3_origins&lang=en)

因为§H虚境§!带来的影响，灵能之力对我们并不陌生。如果我们可以在整个[This.GetAdjective]社会规模上解锁灵能之力，就能完全获得我们应得的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1628`

Psionic forces are not unknown to us, given the influence of the §HShroud§!. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our latent potential.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1979`

## shroud.2780.desc_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_1&lang=en)

### 中文

我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。心灵感应已经取代了人与人之间大部分的口头交流，意念移物可能变得稀松平常。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口觉醒潜在力量了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1644`

### English

Our psionic research continues apace. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of awakening the latent powers in all our [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1997`

## shroud.2780.desc_1_trad

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_1_trad&lang=en)

### 中文

我们觉醒了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。心灵感应取代了人与人之间大多数的口头交流，意念移物也不过家常便饭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1645`

### English

We have awoken. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1998`

## shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的灵能我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有人口觉醒潜在力量了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1646`

### English

Our psionic research continues apace. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of unlocking the latent capabilities throughout our population.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:1999`

## shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine_trad

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine_trad&lang=en)

### 中文

命运降临了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1647`

### English

Destiny is upon us. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2000`

## shroud.2780.desc_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_2&lang=en)

### 中文

随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的力量。最前沿的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们提到了§H虚境§!，这是所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]汲取力量的根源领域，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1648`

### English

As our minds have opened, we have sensed ineffable forces rippling within and around us. Our foremost [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] speak of the §HShroud§!, a primordial realm from which all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power, even if only subconsciously - home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2001`

## shroud.2780.desc_2_crisis

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_2_crisis&lang=en)

### 中文

随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的§H虚境§!之力。我们知道所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]便是从这个根源领域汲取力量的，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1649`

### English

As our minds have opened, we have sensed the ineffable forces of the §HShroud§! rippling within and around us. We know that all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power from this realm, even if only subconsciously - and that it is home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2002`

## shroud.2780.desc_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_3&lang=en)

### 中文

将意念凝聚到一起，或许我们就能与这些存在交流——但前提我们还得学会突破横亘在我们维度和虚境之间的帷幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1650`

### English

With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to commune with these beings - if only we can learn to breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2003`

## shroud.2780.desc_3_chosen

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2780.desc_3_chosen&lang=en)

### 中文

通过集体的认知努力，我们或许有可能完全突破我们维度与虚境之间的帷幕——这将使我们能够与其中的物质进行更深层次的交流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1651`

### English

With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to fully breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud - allowing us to commune more deeply with the beings therein.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2004`

## shroud.2800.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2800.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

在被困于[Owner.GetHypnotic]出神状态多日后，我们终于短暂地打开了一条通往 §H虚境§!的大门。\n\n现在，我们可以以更清晰的视角[Owner.GetSeeVerb]到这个领域，从那漩涡般的混沌中解析出规律。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1659`

### English

After days of being locked in [Owner.GetHypnotic] trance, we have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the §HShroud§!.\n\nNow, we can [Owner.GetSeeVerb] this realm with greater clarity, resolving patterns from the swirling mass.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2013`

## shroud.2800.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2800.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.2800.intro$我们的行动影响灵能流动，无形的实体则从另一边凝视着我们。他们有时好奇，有时友好……有时又带着恶意。[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]\n\n我们的在现实世界掌握灵能只是一个开端。既然已经建立了初步的灵能链接，我们就能将认知的能量集中起来并潜入虚境了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1660`

### English

$shroud.2800.intro$ Our actions influence its shifting flows of psionic energy, and formless entities gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]\n\nOur psionic mastery in the corporeal realm was only the beginning. Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we can combine our cognitive powers and delve into the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2014`

## shroud.2810.desc

### 中文

§H链接新成，环流逆转。\n\n这股能量的扭曲，于此——不过是片段。他人或许也给予了你们力量。灵潜至更深处去面对他们的意志吧。\n\n我是双子之影。血肉之躯胜过废铁。其名为……§!\n\n$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$示意向了另一个存在——虚境深处的$shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1664`

### English

§HNew connection. Current reversed.\n\nThis twist of energy, here - only a fragment. The others might also empower you. Delve further to process their wills.\n\nI am a shadow of the twin. Flesh precedes metal. It calls...§!\n\n$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$ signals toward another presence - $shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$ in the depths of the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2019`

## shroud.5305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对没有准备的人而言，在§H虚境§!的灵域交流十分凶险。\n\n我们可以引导你们完成这个过程，但是要注意：有些居住在里面的实体如果迎接入人的意识里是非常危险的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1675`

### English

Communing in the domains of the §HShroud§! has proven to be a perilous endeavor for the unprepared.\n\nWe can guide you through this process, though take heed: The entities that dwell within can be very dangerous to welcome into one's mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2034`

## shroud.5305.desc_all_contacted

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5305.desc_all_contacted&lang=en)

### 中文

在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。\n\n我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至§H虚境§!如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1676`

### English

We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.\n\nWe commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains of the §HShroud§! and retain such soundness of mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2035`

## shroud.5315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

噢，没错……§H虚境§!，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。\n\n我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。\n\n只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1682`

### English

Oh yes... the §HShroud§! It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.\n\nWe can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidable technologies may bloom, but the path is yours to walk.\n\nJust know this: our coven of telepaths must devote themselves wholly to this task. What lies beyond their guidance... is not ours to control.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2043`

§RThe coven of telepaths needs time to recover. They will not be able to perform a delving ritual until §Y[This.shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_timer]§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2047`

## shroud.5318.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5318.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚境§!再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。\n\n我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1687`

### English

The §HShroud§! proves once again that there are no coincidences.\n\nThe insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in this regard.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2049`

## shroud.5320.desc.none

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5320.desc.none&lang=en)

### 中文

将§H虚境§!显化到物理世界的方法是需要严守的秘密，这一点连我们也无可指教。要释放$PSIONIC_AURA$需要自己深入许多灵域。与最喜欢的实体调和，这项知识就会让你豁然开朗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1688`

### English

The capability to manifest the §HShroud§! in the physical realm is a closely guarded secret, and one that even we cannot teach. To unleash one's $PSIONIC_AURA$ requires a personal journey into its many domains. Attune more heavily to a favored entity, and this knowledge will clarify in your mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2051`

## shroud.5320.desc.aura.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5320.desc.aura.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的$PSIONIC_AURA$是通过与§H虚境§!的调和度来显化的。它影响着周遭的世界，充满了意图。在对话的过程中，我们的巫会已经感知到你们的意图：

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1689`

### English

Your $PSIONIC_AURA$ is your attunement to the §HShroud§! made manifest. It affects all around you, and is filled with intent. Our coven senses the manner of yours as we speak:

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2052`

## shroud.5320.desc.aura.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5320.desc.aura.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1690`

### English

The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2053`

### 中文

称赞你们。你们对$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的认知已经超越了我们。\n\n你们的存在将§H虚境§!中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……

## shroud.5330.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5330.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。\n\n我们知道一种方法……\n\n先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。\n\n我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1706`

### English

As you know, manifesting your §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.\n\nWe know of a way...\n\nThere are more similarities between advanced technology and psionics than one would think. Perhaps this speaks to a greater fundamental truth. In any case, we know of a device that can serve as a conduit for your will. Once you become attuned to its frequencies, it will act as a supplementary mind even across great distances.\n\nOur designs are fully capable of being installed in any suitable starbase. Does such a machine interest you?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2071`

## shroud.5350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。\n\n但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向§H虚境§!的路。\n\n我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1709`

### English

It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.\n\nWe warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the §HShroud§!.\n\nWe do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2075`

## shroud.5355.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5355.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。\n\n然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1712`

### English

Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.\n\nHowever, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2079`

## shroud.5355.b

### English

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2080`

## shroud.5375.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.5375.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！\n\n你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“§H虚境封印§!”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:1714`

### English

You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!\n\nThese '§HShroud Seal§!' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will have no further dealings with you.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2082`

[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。\n\n理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。\n\n这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2253`

### English

Our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.\n\nAccording to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.\n\nIt is a true battle of the minds.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2747`

## shroud.1550.desc.common_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.1550.desc.common_1&lang=en)

### 中文

我们初次涉入§H虚境§!导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2256`

### English

Our forays into the §HShroud§! have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2751`

## shroud.1550.desc.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.1550.desc.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2257`

### English

Our actions ripple throughout the Shroud, drawing us closer to beings of great power. If we find favor with these entities, we might then channel their psionic energy into corporeal reality. Our [GetTelepathPlural] hypothesize that the resulting 'aura' would strengthen our empire,

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:2752`

## shroud.1550.desc_1.knows

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.1550.desc_1.knows&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.1550.desc.common_1$§H“$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$”§!是将这种影响转变成持续流的一种方法。

### English

$shroud.1550.desc.common_1$ §H'$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$'§! present a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

## whisperers_in_the_void_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awhisperers_in_the_void_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

低语在虚境之中心旋转着，这是知晓万物的一切超主所组成的变化不息的融合体。当被召唤时，他们在外部灵域显化，从而直接影响物理世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2475`

### English

At the center of the Shroud spins the Whisperers, an ever-shifting amalgam of all Patrons with knowledge of all things. When called upon, they take their place in the outer domains in order to more directly influence the physical realm.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3054`

## end_of_the_cycle_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aend_of_the_cycle_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在虚境的最核心居住着$end_of_the_cycle_article$。祂是一种灵能意志的融合，是本次元不同灵域之间的巨大平衡力量。没有终末，就没有始源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2483`

### English

At the very center of the Shroud dwells $end_of_the_cycle_article$. An amalgamation of psionic will, it is a great force of balance among the various domains of this dimension. Without ends, there can be no beginnings.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3063`

## situation_end_of_the_cycle_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asituation_end_of_the_cycle_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。\n\n超主的意志将会化为强力的$PSIONIC_AURA$降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。\n\n有待征服的恒星系：§Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2686`

### English

We have forged a Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.\n\nThe will of our patron is manifested in an intense $PSIONIC_AURA$. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.\n\nSystems remaining to be conquered: §Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3299`

## MINDWARDENS_THE_FIRST_ENCLAVE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMINDWARDENS_THE_FIRST_ENCLAVE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经做好了成立独立的§H“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”§!以协助结束星系中灵能侵染行动的准备。\n\n一旦成立，该机构可以为需要的人提供反灵能服务，并以此为我们赚取收入和物资。

### English

We are prepared to construct an independent §H'$gov_mindwarden_enclave$'§! to further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.\n\nOnce constructed, this facility can provide anti-psionic services for those who need them, while providing us a portion of the revenue and materials it receives.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3411`

### English

## SHROUD_SHAPING_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHROUD_SHAPING_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚境§!中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。\n\n然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2789`

### English

The entities within the §HShroud§! are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.\n\nYet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3415`

## EXPLORE_BORDER_SYSTEM_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEXPLORE_BORDER_SYSTEM_DESC&lang=en)

长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与我们[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的$building_ancient_ward_1$发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。\n\n如果我们想理解这个现象，就必须去探索[exiled_system_border.GetName]系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2791`

### English

Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with irregular readings produced by our $building_ancient_ward_1$ on [owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\nIf we wish to understand this phenomenon, we must explore [exiled_system_border.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3418`

## ATTUNEMENT_TT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AATTUNEMENT_TT&lang=en)

### 中文

§H调和度§!代表一位§H超主§!对一个帝国的感兴趣程度。进行['concept_deeds']或完成['concept_callings']可以提升调和度。\n\n与其中一位超主提升调和度将会降低与其逆位超主的调和度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2829`

### English

§HAttunement§! represents the degree to which a §HPatron§! takes interest in an empire. Perform ['concept_deeds'] or complete ['concept_callings'] to increase Attunement.\n\nIncreasing Attunement with one Patron will decrease Attunement with the opposing Patron.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3462`

## ATTUNEMENT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AATTUNEMENT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§L虚境中的实体不判断何谓对错，只关心能否让自己欢欣。每个灵域都镌刻着一种意欲，唯有与之调和者允许自由涉足。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2830`

### English

§LThe entities within the Shroud hold no judgement over what is right or wrong, only what pleases or displeases them. Each domain is carved with specific intent, and only those who are attuned properly can enter them freely.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3463`

### English

## shroud.10.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.10.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境回响着前所未有的残暴。巨大的能量弧在以太中翻滚不息。\n\n在狂乱闪烁的混沌中，我们看到了合成女王的灵能回声。她无边无际、无所不能，将整个星系玩弄于股掌之间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2958`

### English

The Shroud reverberates with an unprecedented ferocity. Vast coils of energy writhe and thrash in the ether.\n\nAmid the strobing disorder, we behold the psionic echoes of the synthetic queen. Infinite and omnipotent, she toys with the galaxy in her palm.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3604`

## shroud.10.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.10.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

怎会如此？难道祂知道什么我们不知道的弱点吗？如果我们向祂伸出援手，它会帮我们吗？\n\n把注意力集中在塑师身上时，我们感受到祂的不耐烦。我们很可能只有一次机会就这个问题向祂求助。为此我们可能需要非常大量的§H能量币§!和§H$sr_zro$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2959`

### English

Why? Does it know of a weakness we do not? Will it assist us if we reach out to it?\n\nAs we focus our minds upon the Animator, we sense its impatience. It is very likely that we will only have one opportunity to ask for its aid in this matter. Massive quantities of §HEnergy§! and §H$sr_zro$§! will be needed for the effort.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3605`

## shroud.10.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.10.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.10.desc.intro$\n\n并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，一个叫做$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$的实体也俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。\n\n$shroud.10.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:2960`

### English

$shroud.10.desc.intro$\n\nWe are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the entity known as $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.\n\n$shroud.10.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3606`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.10.desc.1&lang=en)

$shroud.10.desc.intro$\n\n并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$也悄然俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。\n\n$shroud.10.desc.outro$

### English

$shroud.10.desc.intro$\n\nWe are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.\n\n$shroud.10.desc.outro$

## shroud.3000.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.title&lang=en)

### 中文

短暂印象

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3002`

### English

Fleeting Impressions

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3651`

## shroud.3000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。\n\n或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？\n\n那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。\n\n§H你看到了什么？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3003`

### English

In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.\n\nThere is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?\n\nA presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.\n\n§HWHAT DO YOU SEE?§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3652`

## shroud.3000.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们见到了一个燃烧的世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3004`

### English

We see a world that burns.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3653`

## shroud.3000.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

重量转移；心声复现……\n\n§H很好。§!\n\n那片黑暗倾斜、旋转起来。有什么东西重重压在我们身上，然后，我们突然又余下独自一人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3005`

### English

A weight shifts; the voice returns...\n\n§HGOOD.§!\n\nThe darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3654`

## shroud.3000.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.b&lang=en)

我们看到了一场盛典。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3006`

### English

We see a celebration.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3655`

## shroud.3000.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3000.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

有个沉重的东西在颤抖。黑暗慢慢地向我们袭来，愈发凝重……\n\n§H不！§!\n\n那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3007`

### English

Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...\n\n§HNO!§!\n\nThe nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3656`

### English

§HWEAKNESS!§!\n\nThe nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

## shroud.3005.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3005.title&lang=en)

### 中文

垂涎之饥

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3010`

### English

Salivating Hunger

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3660`

## shroud.3005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。\n\n幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。\n\n一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。\n\n饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？\n\n束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：\n\n§H撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3011`

### English

The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.\n\nImages, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.\n\nSilhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.\n\nOur senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?\n\nThe shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:\n\n§HSHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3661`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3005.a&lang=en)

斩断锁链。吞噬猎物。

### English

Break the chains. Consume the prey.

我们的束缚崩断。\n\n贪婪。释放。\n\n恐惧！\n\n§H吞噬。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3014`

### English

Our restraints snap.\n\nRavenous. Unleashed.\n\nTerror!\n\n§HFEED.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3664`

## shroud.3005.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3005.b&lang=en)

### 中文

抵抗饥饿。宁心静气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3015`

### English

Resist the hunger. Quieten the mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3665`

## shroud.3005.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3005.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

锁链牢固。我们过滤掉它的影响后，心声充满愤怒，我们的意识冷静下来并恢复了控制。\n\n§H软弱！无力！§!\n\n饥饿褪去，留下挥之不去的怨恨消散在虚境中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3016`

### English

The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.\n\n§HWEAK! FECKLESS!§!\n\nThe hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3666`

## shroud.3010.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3010.title&lang=en)

### 中文

献祭之宴

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3017`

### English

Sacrificial Feast

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3668`

## shroud.3010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。\n\n§H供养。消耗。吞噬。§!\n\n幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。\n\n随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3018`

### English

From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.\n\n§HFEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.§!\n\nVisions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.\n\nAs these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3669`

### English

## shroud.3010.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3010.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。\n\n以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3022`

### English

The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.\n\nWith this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3673`

## shroud.3010.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3010.b&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3674`

## shroud.3010.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3010.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们抑制了这个心声，团结一致地探向虚境，拥抱着自己的帝国。随着饥饿的加剧，众口一声地舒了一口气，舒适感淹没了愤怒的尖叫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3024`

### English

We silence the voice, and instead reach out in unity across the Shroud, embracing our empire. A collective sigh of relief and comfort drowns out the screams of rage as the hunger deteriorates.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3675`

## shroud.3015.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3015.title&lang=en)

### 中文

转瞬幻视

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3025`

### English

Transient Visions

## shroud.3015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。\n\n突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。\n\n一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。\n\n§H所见何物？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3026`

### English

Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.\n\nSuddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.\n\nA strange presence settles around us.\n\n§HWHAT DID YOU SEE?§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3678`

## shroud.3020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。\n\n浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。\n\n这只动物本身我们前所未见。\n\n一个心声回荡在我们之内。\n\n§H命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3034`

### English

From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.\n\nThe mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.\n\nThe animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.\n\nA voice threads its way within us.\n\n§HTHE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3687`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3036`

### English

The voice echoes in our [GetMindLoc] as the creature fades from sight.\n\n§HPROSPERITY.§!\n\nAnother fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3689`

那心声从我们的思想中退去，只留下一声悠长的悲鸣，回荡在一片荒芜的景象中。\n\n§H造孽。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3038`

### English

The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.\n\n§HPESTILENCE.§!

## shroud.3020.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3020.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

一种压倒性的冲动占据了我们的思想，这个心声被从思想中推开到一边。血腥的欲望充斥着我们的[GetMindLoc]，残酷的笑声在虚空中回荡。\n\n§H这就对了！虐杀！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3041`

### English

The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our [GetMindLoc] as brutal laughter echoes through the void.\n\n§HOF COURSE! EASY PREY!§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3694`

## shroud.3025.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.title&lang=en)

### 中文

变化地景

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3042`

### English

Morphing Landscapes

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3696`

## shroud.3025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。\n\n朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。\n\n在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。\n\n一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。\n\n§H如此无序。作茧自缚。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3043`

### English

The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.\n\nObscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.\n\nBeneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.\n\nThrough the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].\n\n§HSUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3697`

## shroud.3025.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.a&lang=en)

### 中文

让自然向我们的意志低头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3044`

### English

Bend nature to our will.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3698`

## shroud.3025.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。\n\n将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。\n\n将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。\n\n§H单调，平淡，空虚……§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3045`

### English

We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.\n\nBinding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.\n\nAs the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.\n\n§HFLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3699`

## shroud.3025.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.b&lang=en)

### 中文

任由自然的无序繁盛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3046`

### English

Let nature's disorder flourish.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3700`

## shroud.3025.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。\n\n能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。\n\n心声回响起来。\n\n§H和平即冲突。无序即和谐。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3047`

### English

We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.\n\nEnergies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.\n\nThe voice echoes.\n\n§HPEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3701`

## shroud.3025.b.reply.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3025.b.reply.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

行星获得随机§G正面修正§!和§R负面修正§!各一个。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3048`

### English

This planet gains a random §GPositive Modifier§! and §RNegative Modifier§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3702`

## shroud.3030.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.title&lang=en)

### 中文

黑暗中的棱镜

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3049`

### English

Prism in the Darkness

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3704`

## shroud.3030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。\n\n前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。\n\n无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。\n\n在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。\n\n§H所示之物即所见，对吗？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3050`

### English

The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.\n\nAhead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.\n\nCountless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.\n\nUpon the nearby sand, a presence settles.\n\n§HWHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3705`

## shroud.3030.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们看到了许多声音汇聚一堂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3051`

### English

We saw a conference of many voices.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3706`

## shroud.3030.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。\n\n§H很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。§!\n\n我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3052`

### English

The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.\n\n§HGOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.§!\n\nWe feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3707`

## shroud.3030.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.b&lang=en)

我们看到了战斗中的屠戮。

### English

We saw the carnage of battle.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3708`

## shroud.3030.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。\n\n§H不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！§!\n\n沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3054`

### English

The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.\n\n§HNO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!§!\n\nThe sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3709`

我们不确定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3055`

### English

We are unsure.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3710`

## shroud.3030.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3030.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

沙子缓慢地流动这。\n\n§H犹豫会滋生失败……§!\n\n我们又复归一人了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3056`

### English

The sands shift slowly.\n\n§HHESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...§!\n\nWe are alone again.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3711`

## shroud.3035.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.title&lang=en)

### 中文

影争暗斗

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3057`

### English

Shadow Brawl

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3713`

## shroud.3035.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。\n\n暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。\n\n一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。\n\n§H来到此地者需呈递良方。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3058`

### English

The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.\n\nShadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.\n\nA foreign presence presses into our [GetMindPhysicalLoc], invasive and vast.\n\n§HTHOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3714`

## shroud.3035.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.a&lang=en)

### 中文

对话铸就理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3059`

### English

Dialogue fosters understanding.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3715`

## shroud.3035.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

迷雾消退淡出，溶解进背后的灵能能量旋涡中。那个意识回来了。\n\n§H和谐就是智慧§!\n\n虚境现在变得平静了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3060`

### English

The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.\n\n§HHARMONY IS WISDOM.§!\n\nThe Shroud is calmer now.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3716`

## shroud.3035.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.b&lang=en)

### 中文

妥协就是示弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3061`

### English

Compromise is weakness.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3717`

## shroud.3035.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3035.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

随着迷雾的每一击落地，我们周围的能量都在加剧沸腾。\n\n§H暴力是对无知的嘉奖。§!\n\n虚境流速能量再次抽搐了起来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3062`

### English

With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.\n\n§HVIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.§!\n\nThe Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3718`

## shroud.3040.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.title&lang=en)

### 中文

未见之景

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3063`

### English

Sights Unseen

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3720`

## shroud.3040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。\n\n突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。\n\n一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。\n\n§H你看到了未见之物吗？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3064`

### English

A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.\n\nSuddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.\n\nA voice resonates within the recesses of our [GetMindLoc].\n\n§HYOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3721`

## shroud.3040.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们见到了一个等待开掘的采石场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3065`

### English

We saw a quarry, waiting for the pick.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3722`

## shroud.3040.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。\n\n§H无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。§!\n\n随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3066`

### English

A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.\n\n§HGROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.§!\n\nAs the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3723`

## shroud.3040.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们看到了应当保护的完美自然。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3067`

### English

We saw nature's perfection, to be preserved.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3724`

## shroud.3040.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。\n\n§H不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！§!\n\n液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3068`

### English

The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.\n\n§HUNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!§!\n\nThe surface settles again. The voice has departed.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3725`

## shroud.3040.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.c&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不确定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3069`

### English

We are unsure.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3726`

## shroud.3040.c.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3040.c.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

液体搅动着。心声再次显现。\n\n§H信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。§!\n\n随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3070`

### English

The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.\n\n§HCONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.§!\n\nAs the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3727`

## shroud.3045.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.title&lang=en)

### 中文

发光内核

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3071`

### English

Luminous Kernel

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3729`

## shroud.3045.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。\n\n走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。\n\n在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。\n\n一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。\n\n§H占有。夺取。利用。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3072`

### English

The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.\n\nIts immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.\n\nEnsconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.\n\nA voice settles in our [GetMindLoc].\n\n§HACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3730`

## shroud.3045.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.a&lang=en)

### 中文

把它取出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3073`

### English

Extract it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3731`

## shroud.3045.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

内核取出后，树冠暗淡了下来然后立刻就枯萎了。那个心声又回来了。\n\n§H没错！破坏才有收获。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3074`

### English

As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.\n\n§HYES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3732`

## shroud.3045.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.b&lang=en)

保持原样。

Leave it untouched.

## shroud.3045.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3045.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

一阵震颤穿过我们的身体。分不清震颤的是这个世界，还是我们自己？\n\n§H繁荣才有意义。逃避是愚痴！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3076`

### English

A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?\n\n§HPROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3734`

## shroud.3050.desc.eater

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3050.desc.eater&lang=en)

### 中文

痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3080`

### English

Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

## shroud.3050.desc.composer

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3050.desc.composer&lang=en)

### 中文

哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3081`

### English

Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3740`

## shroud.3050.desc.cradle

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3050.desc.cradle&lang=en)

### 中文

各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3082`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3083`

Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3090`

### English

Amid the shadowy murk, one thing catches our attention. Unmistakable and central: it is the flag of [Root.GetName].\n\nIs this us?

## shroud.3060.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。\n\n我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3102`

### English

The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.\n\nOur [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3763`

## shroud.3060.desc.intro.organic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.desc.intro.organic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3103`

### English

We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3764`

## shroud.3060.desc.intro.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.desc.intro.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3104`

### English

Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3765`

## shroud.3060.desc.intro.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.desc.intro.end&lang=en)

### 中文

张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3105`

### English

As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3766`

## shroud.3060.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3106`

### English

The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3767`

## shroud.3060.desc.eater

## shroud.3060.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。\n\n我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。\n\n然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。§H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§!不在岗了。那心声又回来了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3112`

### English

The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.\n\nWe have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.\n\nHowever, not all of us remain. §H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§! is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3773`

## shroud.3060.b.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.b.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。\n\n循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。\n\n心声又回来了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3119`

### English

We reject the compulsions forced upon us.\n\nThe loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.\n\nThe voice returns.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3780`

## shroud.3060.leader_return.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3060.leader_return.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。\n\n§H[from.GetName]§!回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3126`

### English

The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.\n\n§H[from.GetName]§! returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3787`

## leader_trait_shroud_warped_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aleader_trait_shroud_warped_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被虚境吸收后重构了，降临在其身上的天外之愿使其拥有了观测不可观测之事的能力，其灵能潜力也大幅倍增了。

### English

A Bidden Chalice

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3794`

## shroud.3065.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3065.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。\n\n我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。\n\n一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。\n\n我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3132`

### English

The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.\n\nA compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].\n\nClarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.\n\nWe are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3795`

## shroud.3065.a.reply.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3065.a.reply.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

最后一滴液体被咽下，它粘稠得令人作呕，在体内积聚，饱和着我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]。\n\n一股暖流涌上全身，扭曲着我们的思想，磨损了[GetPsycheLoc]的边缘。\n\n那个声音带着满足归来，圣杯在我们面前消融。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3140`

### English

The last of the liquid sloughs down, thick and repugnant. Pooling within us, saturating our [GetMindPhysicalLoc].\n\nHeat pulsates through us, warping our thoughts, fraying the edges of our [GetPsycheLoc].\n\nThe voice returns, satisfied, as the chalice dissolves before us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3803`

## shroud.3070.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。\n\n一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3154`

### English

The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.\n\nA presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering reveal unleashes a cascade of visions.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3818`

## shroud.3070.desc.eater

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.eater&lang=en)

### 中文

星球燃烧，被吞噬者的哀号携带着灰烬。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一场等待被吞噬的盛宴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3155`

### English

Worlds burn, their embers carried by the lamentations of the consumed. Each shifting vista reveals a potential feast, ready to be devoured.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3819`

## shroud.3070.desc.composer

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.composer&lang=en)

### 中文

漫山遍野，翠绿的平原上到处都是成群的野生动物。生命的丝缕缠绕、伸展着。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个充满变化和塑造潜力的大气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3156`

### English

Overflowing landscapes, saturated with wildlife swarming over verdant plains. Threads of life entwine and expand. Each shifting vista reveals a teeming atmosphere of potential to shift and mold.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3820`

## shroud.3070.desc.cradle

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.cradle&lang=en)

### 中文

社群相互接纳，团结互助，求同存异。每一副变化的远景都揭示了一个新的乌托邦，只欢迎着忠实的人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3157`

### English

Communities embracing, uplifting each other in unity at the cost of shunning those who dissent. Each shifting vista reveals a new utopia, welcoming only the faithful.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3821`

## shroud.3070.desc.instrument

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.instrument&lang=en)

### 中文

宽广的采石场在我们面前伸展开，里面排列着丰厚的资源等待开采。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个等待夺取的财富宝库。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3158`

### English

Vast quarries extend out before us, lined with lucrative resources rife for extraction. Each shifting vista reveals a trove of riches waiting to be plundered.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3822`

## shroud.3070.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3070.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

每见到一幅新的幻景，我们就会被惯性翻转扭曲，拖向不可能的极速，伴随着现实之墙弯曲起伏。\n\n我们理解了这个大人物的乐趣。祂在考验我们，等待着给吸引我们的那股力量一个称呼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3159`

### English

With each new vision, inertia flips and twists us, dragging us through impossible speeds as the walls of reality bend and ripple.\n\nWe sense the figure's amusement. It is testing us, awaiting a name for the force that grips us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3823`

我们大声呼喊，那个存在停住了。随着惯性的风暴安定下来变得向量而清晰，千变万化的幻景也停了下来。\n\n我们给出了一个称呼。

## shroud.3100.title

### 中文

灵能冲突

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3182`

### English

Psionic Conflict

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3847`

## shroud.3100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。\n\n噪音具象化了。\n\n我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。\n\n灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3183`

### English

A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.\n\nThe noise takes its form.\n\nWe are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities involved is unclear, but the power on display is significant.\n\nThe psychic bombardments slip in and out of our perception, twisting through the fractured reality before us. There is no cover, only an approaching storm.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3848`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3100.a&lang=en)

### English

§YEndure and observe.§!

### English

§GUnceasing Resonance§!

## shroud.3101.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3101.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

随着冲突越来越近，我们冒着激怒祂们的风险徘徊着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3186`

### English

We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3851`

## shroud.3101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3101.desc.intro$\n\n清晰聚焦后，我们就能让自己适应灵能瀑布，思想也会变得流畅。轰炸并没有减弱，但我们却毫发无损，反而是随着毁灭的节奏和谐地移动着。\n\n每进一步，我们的理解力就会增长。灵能的弹幕在不可见的位面之间滑移。\n\n我们退出时，这种模式仍然存在。经过改进，我们所观察到的这些原理就可以用在我们的武备上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3187`

### English

$shroud.3101.desc.intro$\n\nWith clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.\n\nWith each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.\n\nAs we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3852`

## shroud.3102.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3102.title&lang=en)

### 中文

§R深渊轰炸§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3188`

### English

§RAbyssal Barrage§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3853`

## shroud.3102.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3102.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3101.desc.intro$我们尝试与这场灵能风暴调和，跟随着它不可预测的韵律移动。\n\n虽然开头几步看起来还很有机会，但这毁灭的节奏最后还是不可避免地把我们吞噬了。\n\n随着风暴过去，轰炸的回响依旧在体内回荡。所遭遇的失败依旧回响在本现实的帝国当中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3189`

### English

$shroud.3101.desc.intro$ We attempt to attune to the psychic storm, moving with its unpredictable rhythms.\n\nOur first steps showed promise, but the tempo of destruction inevitably consumed us.\n\nAs the storm passes, the echoes of the barrage still ring through us. The psionic reverberations of our failure echo through the empire in even this reality.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3854`

## shroud.3105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。\n\n一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。\n\n另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。\n\n在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3192`

### English

Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.\n\nA labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.\n\nAnother surge begins to build. With concentration, we sense its configuration before it emerges. The shifting maze ignites again, bursting outward into a network of possibilities.\n\nEach path provides a new temptation to explore, before it collapses into nothingness.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3858`

### English

§G$tech_psionic_lightning$§!

### English

§G$tech_psionic_lightning$§!
