## shroud.3106.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3106.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

压力越来越大，期望在逗弄着我们。我们随着之上涌，让思想穿过这座精神迷宫。思绪变成了驱策着我们前进的动量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3195`

### English

The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3861`

## shroud.3106.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3106.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3106.desc.intro$趁我们在决心动摇之前穿梭在灵能的能量弧之间。\n\n我们无拘无束，超越了物质形态。迷宫和其内的无数道路成为我们意识的延伸，找到了深藏在这场模式的风暴中的知识。\n\n这一刻开始得很快，结束得也很快。我们再次带着新寻见的理解涌现，而迷宫的残影也在身后陡然崩塌。这些灵能原理经过仔细的改进后就可以应用到我们的武器上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3196`

### English

$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.\n\nWe are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.\n\nAs swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3862`

## shroud.3107.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3107.title&lang=en)

### 中文

§R迷失虚空§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3197`

### English

§RLost in the Void§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3863`

## shroud.3107.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3107.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3106.desc.intro$但亿万条道路在面前盘根错节，让我们无从选择。\n\n就在我们犹豫的这一刹那，一条条灿然辉映的道路骤然迸裂。灵能能量的弧光在崩塌的枢纽中扭曲穿行，将思绪连带缠绕，并将我们抛入虚境的混沌之中。\n\n我们浮出现实，[GetTelepathPlural]们迷失了，陷入了失败的痛苦之中。灵能的反冲在整个[Root.GetName]回荡着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3198`

### English

$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ Its myriad pathways sprawl before us, overwhelming the mind with impossible choices.\n\nIn this moment of hesitation, the incandescent paths erupt. Arcs of psionic energy twist through the collapsing nexus, ensnaring our thoughts and casting us into the chaos of the Shroud.\n\nWe emerge, our [GetTelepathPlural] disoriented and burdened by the trauma of failure. The psionic backlash reverberates through [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3864`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3110.title&lang=en)

### English

## shroud.3110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。\n\n逗留于此不知是否安全？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3200`

### English

A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.\n\nIs it safe to remain here?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3867`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3110.a&lang=en)

### English

§YStay here a while.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3868`

### English

## shroud.3111.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3111.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。\n\n我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3203`

### English

Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.\n\nOur minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3870`

## shroud.3112.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3112.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们无法留存。靠近如此高强度的灵能能量构造使我们的[GetTelepathPlural]不堪重负。\n\n接触这种压倒性的现象对我们心智的损伤需要一段时间才能恢复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3205`

### English

We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our [GetTelepathPlural].\n\nThe damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3872`

## shroud.3120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。\n\n我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。\n\n我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3214`

### English

Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.\n\nOur actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can extend their reach directly toward these entities.\n\nWe need only decide which to seek out.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3882`

## shroud.3125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在与这个存在接触的过程中能够[GetFeelSenseLoc]到它的搅动。我们曾见过这个[GetSpiritsLoc]，但这次又有些许不同，祂变得无可估量地强大……也更加地远古。\n\n我们[GetTelepathPlural]的泽珞耗尽了能量，必须从虚境中撤离了。我们还会再回来的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3222`

### English

As we reach out for the presence, we can [GetFeelSenseLoc] it stirring. We have encountered [GetSpiritsLoc] before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.\n\nTheir Zro-infused energies depleted, our [GetTelepathPlural] must withdraw from the Shroud. We will have to return later.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3891`

## shroud.3115.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3115.title&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能轰炸

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3224`

### English

Psionic Bombardment

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3894`

## shroud.3115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。\n\n这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。\n\n这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3225`

### English

A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.\n\nThese reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].\n\nWhat is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3895`

## shroud.3115.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3115.a&lang=en)

### English

## shroud.3116.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3116.title&lang=en)

### 中文

§G$tech_psionic_bombers$§!

### English

§G$tech_psionic_bombers$§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3897`

## shroud.3116.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3116.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。\n\n这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。\n\n从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3228`

### English

We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.\n\nThe explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.\n\nAn insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3898`

## shroud.3117.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3117.title&lang=en)

### 中文

§R灵能震撼§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3229`

### English

§RPsionic Shock§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3899`

## shroud.3117.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3117.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的精神储备已经衰退了。\n\n这种心灵爆炸排山倒海而来，诱发了许多[GetTelepathPlural]的灵能休克。\n\n我们需要时间来恢复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3230`

### English

Our mental reserves have waned.\n\nThe psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our [GetTelepathPlural].\n\nWe will need time to recover.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3900`

## shroud.3200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$面前。\n\n脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。\n\n虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。\n\n现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3238`

### English

As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$.\n\nClockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.\n\nWhile not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.\n\nNo longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3909`

禁制之意

Will of Temperance

## shroud.3210.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3210.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

$the_outsider_color_article$哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。\n\n祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。\n\n§H有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。\n\n我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3242`

### English

The mournful essence of $the_outsider_color_article$ seeps into our minds.\n\nAs its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.\n\n§HSome things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.\n\nI was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3914`

## shroud.3210.desc.know_zroni

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3210.desc.know_zroni&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认出了这个声音是泽珞族的。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3243`

### English

$shroud.3210.desc.intro$We recognize this voice as Zroni. How this one came to be here is unclear, but perhaps it is wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3915`

## shroud.3210.desc.left_zroni

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3210.desc.left_zroni&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3244`

### English

$shroud.3210.desc.intro$We know of this one. We have encountered this Zroni, the 'Far-Seer', before. How it came to be here is unclear, but we would be wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3916`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3245`

### English

$shroud.3210.desc.intro$This entity remains a mystery to us. We understand little of its ominous warning.

## shroud.3220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着$the_golden_dream_color_article$安宁的律动。\n\n我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。\n\n它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。\n\n我们意识到自己正在$the_golden_dream_article$的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3249`

### English

All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of $the_golden_dream_color_article$.\n\nAs we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.\n\nThey begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.\n\nWe realize we are party to a game with $the_golden_dream_article$. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3922`

## shroud.3230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了$the_endless_tide_color_article$粗粝的面孔。\n\n祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。\n\n祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3253`

### English

Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of $the_endless_tide_color_article$.\n\nIt ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.\n\nRe-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3927`

## shroud.3240.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3240.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是$the_pale_mountain_color_article$。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。\n\n我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。\n\n倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。\n\n舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3257`

### English

A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is $the_pale_mountain_color_article$ itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.\n\nWe see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.\n\nSomewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.\n\nOnce the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3932`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3936`

## shroud.3250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$the_hollow_point_color_article$的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。\n\n我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。\n\n$the_hollow_point_article$的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3261`

### English

The serenity of $the_hollow_point_color_article$ fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.\n\nWe observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.\n\nThe wisdom of $the_hollow_point_article$ is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3937`

## shroud.3260.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3260.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是$the_vacant_throne_color_article$。\n\n随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。\n\n某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3265`

### English

The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is $the_vacant_throne_color_article$.\n\nAs it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.\n\nSomething forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3942`

## shroud.3270.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3270.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是$the_black_river_color_article$出现了。\n\n我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。\n\n当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3269`

### English

An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of $the_black_river_color_article$.\n\nWe rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.\n\nFinally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3947`

## shroud.3500.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3500.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从§H虚境§!里抽取能量的绝妙方法。\n\n灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。\n\n将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3276`

### English

Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the §HShroud§!.\n\nThe greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.\n\nBy projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3956`

### English

Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3957`

## shroud.3510.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3510.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个§H虚境§!的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。\n\n汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。\n\n通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3279`

### English

In a fold of the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.\n\nConvergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.\n\nBy force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3960`

## shroud.3520.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.3520.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将意志投射在§H虚境§!中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。\n\n其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。\n\n§H[this.GetName]§!已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3287`

### English

By projecting our will into the §HShroud§!, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.\n\nWhere others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.\n\nThe psionic potential of the §H[this.GetName]§! has been fulfilled.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3969`

## shroud.first_contact.1.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.1.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。\n\n我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。\n\n这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。\n\n要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3294`

### English

The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.\n\nWe spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.\n\nIts presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.\n\nIf only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3978`

## shroud.first_contact.1.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.1.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。\n\n我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。\n\n这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。\n\n要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3295`

### English

The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.\n\nWe spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.\n\nIts presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.\n\nIf only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3979`

## shroud.first_contact.1.desc.robot

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.1.desc.robot&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。\n\n我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。\n\n这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。\n\n要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3296`

### English

The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.\n\nWe spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.\n\nIts presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.\n\nIf only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3980`

## shroud.first_contact.2.desc.all

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.2.desc.all&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。\n\n无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3297`

### English

We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.\n\nWhatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3982`

## shroud.first_contact.2.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.2.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。\n\n也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3298`

### English

Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.\n\nPerhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3983`

## shroud.first_contact.2.desc.robot

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.2.desc.robot&lang=en)

### 中文

在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。\n\n也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3299`

### English

Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.\n\nPerhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3984`

## shroud.first_contact.3.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.3.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。\n\n我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。\n\n我们势不回头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3300`

### English

We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.\n\nAs soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.\n\nWe must not turn away.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3986`

## shroud.first_contact.3.desc.robot

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.3.desc.robot&lang=en)

### 中文

我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。\n\n我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。\n\n我们势不回头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3301`

### English

We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.\n\nAs soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.\n\nWe must not turn away.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3987`

## shroud.first_contact.4.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.4.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。\n\n我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。\n\n我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3302`

### English

The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.\n\nWe sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.\n\nCan we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3989`

## shroud.first_contact.4.desc.robot

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.first_contact.4.desc.robot&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。\n\n我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。\n\n我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3303`

### English

The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.\n\nWe sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.\n\nWill our circuits overload before we can reach it?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3990`

## shroud.4005.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4005.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

向§H虚境§!深处探索，我们来到了§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视令人窒息。\n\n渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智，回荡在成片的废墟和[GetEaterEmergesExtra]\n\n之间。排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们身上仅余下痛苦的饥饿。\n\n如今，这个实体的意志已更加清晰地呈现在我们面前。[GetEaterEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3308`

### English

Probing deeper into the §HShroud§!, we came within reach of the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was suffocating.\n\nEventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]\n\nAs suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left with an aching hunger.\n\nThe will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3997`

## shroud.4005.desc.gestalt_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4005.desc.gestalt_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

向§H虚境§!深处探索，我们来到了§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。\n\n渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]\n\n排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3310`

### English

Probing deeper into the §HShroud§!, we came within reach of the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.\n\nEventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]\n\nAs suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.\n\nThe will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:3999`

## shroud.4015.desc.default.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4015.desc.default.end&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们停步沉思时，这个实体现出了身形。我们一无所闻、一无所见，但却感受到无上的温暖。\n\n我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上出现了宁静的沉重。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3334`

### English

As we paused to consider, the entity emerged. We heard nothing, saw nothing, but we felt it warmer than ever.\n\nWe felt the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - thoughts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves heavy with quietude.\n\nThe wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4024`

## shroud.4015.desc.gestalt_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4015.desc.gestalt_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的力量弥散在§H虚境§!中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。\n\n我们停步沉思，这个实体却如浮出水面。我们无法解析消息，但它激活了代码的更深层部分。\n\n我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上充满了宁静。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3335`

### English

The power of the §H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§! is diffused throughout the §HShroud§!, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.\n\nAs we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.\n\nWe sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.\n\nThe wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4025`

## shroud.4025.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4025.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们跟随着§H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的气味，被带进§H虚境§!的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。\n\n终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的景象：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。\n\n我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却沉浸在威严的形体和数字之中。这个景象复归沉寂。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$接触、交流了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3352`

### English

We followed the scent of the §H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!, drawn farther into the §HShroud§!. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.\n\nEventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of pungent designs.\n\nWe grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we basked in the majesty of forms and figures. The presence withdrew into silence.\n\nThe intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4043`

## shroud.4025.desc.gestalt_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4025.desc.gestalt_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

我们跟随着§H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的分子踪迹，被带进§H虚境§!的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。\n\n终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的幻景：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。\n\n我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号开始组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却仍旧处理着这些非凡的数据集。随后景象复归沉寂。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$接触、交流了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3354`

### English

We followed the molecular traces of the §H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!, drawn farther into the §HShroud§!. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.\n\nEventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of incongruent designs.\n\nWe grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we processed the remarkable dataset. The presence withdrew into silence.\n\nThe intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4045`

## shroud.4035.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4035.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$\n\n祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息十分诱人：那是一种关于力量与放纵的愿景。\n\n$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3368`

### English

$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$\n\nIts message was a deluge. Thoughts drove into our minds with force, speaking to our wildest desires. Words poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our minds. The message was beguiling: a vision of power and indulgence.\n\n$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4060`

## shroud.4035.desc.default.end

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给予了我们不可熄灭的渴望。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$接触、交流了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3369`

### English

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a thirst beyond quenching.\n\nThe needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4061`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4035.desc.gestalt_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$\n\n祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的电路，超出了过往一切的输入。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。\n\n$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3371`

### English

$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$\n\nIts message was a deluge. Data drove into our circuits with force, exceeding all previous input. Exotic code poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our systems. The message was energizing: a vision of measureless output.\n\n$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4063`

## shroud.4035.desc.machine.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4035.desc.machine.end&lang=en)

### 中文

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给我们留下了破碎的虚空，渴望优雅的输入。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$接触、交流了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3372`

### English

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a fragmented void that craves elegant input.\n\nThe needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4064`

## shroud.4040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们知道许多§H虚境§!中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——§H繁多的嘈杂§!渗透到虚境的最中心。\n\n使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3384`

### English

We know many voices within the §HShroud§!; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a §Hmanifold thrum§! permeating the very center of the Shroud.\n\nWith sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4077`

## shroud.4045.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4045.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

在尝试与§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$。\n\n刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。\n\n§H倾听是一种奉献。§!\n\n如果想抽取这份强大的力量，我们必须帮助这个实体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3387`

### English

In our efforts to commune with the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§! we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$.\n\nA rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].\n\n§HListening is a sacrifice.§!\n\nTo draw on this great power, we must assist the entity in occupying

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4080`

## shroud.4050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]\n\n在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个§H$code_name_animator$§!，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。\n\n祂的行动被打断后靠了过来，驱散开了虚境的浓雾。祂给了我们一样东西。\n\n如果我们拿了会发生什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3408`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]\n\nIn a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a §H$code_name_animator$§!, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.\n\nHaving intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.\n\nWhat will happen if we grasp it?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4105`

### English

$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$ Emerges

## shroud.4055.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4055.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到§H$code_name_animator$§!短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。\n\n顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。\n\n它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3410`

### English

As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the §H$code_name_animator$§! momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.\n\nThe pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.\n\nSlowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4107`

## shroud.4055.desc.know_animator

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4055.desc.know_animator&lang=en)

### 中文

我们意识到这个实体并不陌生。$the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$玩得很开心。凡是无生命之物被唤醒，或是沉闷之物充盈起了灵魂的地方，都能找到祂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3411`

### English

We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. $the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$ was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4108`

人偶摆脱丝线自由舞蹈。

## shroud.4060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]\n\n我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个§H$code_name_outsider$§!正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。\n\n一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。\n\n不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3413`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]\n\nWe sense we are not alone. A §H$code_name_outsider$§! encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.\n\nA deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.\n\nWhatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4111`

$the_outsider_article_cap$显形

## shroud.4065.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4065.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

这个被称为§H$code_name_outsider$§!的遥远的力量从§H虚境§!深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：\n\n§H在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3415`

### English

The distant power known as §H$code_name_outsider$§! seared our minds with anguish from deep within the §HShroud§!. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:\n\n§HTread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4113`

## shroud.4065.desc.outro_default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4065.desc.outro_default&lang=en)

### 中文

不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3416`

### English

Whatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4114`

## shroud.4065.desc.outro_know_zroni

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4065.desc.outro_know_zroni&lang=en)

### 中文

这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？\n\n不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3417`

### English

This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?\n\nWhatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4115`

## shroud.4065.desc.outro_left_zroni

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4065.desc.outro_left_zroni&lang=en)

### 中文

我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在§H星界裂隙§!那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的$the_outsider_color_article$吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3418`

### English

We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an §HAstral Rift§!. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now $the_outsider_color_article$?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4116`

## shroud.4070.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4070.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]\n\n一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。\n\n随着感官的消退，§H$code_name_tide$§!也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。\n\n这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3422`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]\n\nA shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.\n\nAs the sensation subsides, the §H$code_name_tide$§! sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.\n\nThese tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4121`

## shroud.4075.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4075.title&lang=en)

### 中文

$the_endless_tide_article_cap$显形

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3423`

### English

$the_endless_tide_article_cap$ Emerges

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4122`

## shroud.4075.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$code_name_tide$§!从§H虚境§!中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。\n\n一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。\n\n在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。\n\n$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3424`

### English

The §H$code_name_tide$§! has been unearthed from the §HShroud§!. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.\n\nA textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.\n\nWithin this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.\n\n$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$ stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4123`

## shroud.4075.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4075.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这种智慧现在归我们所有。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3425`

### English

This wisdom is now ours.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4124`

## shroud.4080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]\n\n我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。\n\n从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的§H$code_name_mountain$§!究竟有多么巨大。\n\n最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3426`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]\n\nThe gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.\n\nFrom atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the §H$code_name_mountain$§! before us.\n\nThe tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4126`

## shroud.4085.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4085.title&lang=en)

$the_pale_mountain_article_cap$显形

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3427`

### English

$the_pale_mountain_article_cap$ Emerges

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4127`

## shroud.4085.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4085.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们在§H虚境§!中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。§H$code_name_mountain$§!亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。\n\n遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。\n\n然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。\n\n$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$在我们的意识中拔地而起。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3428`

### English

As we ascended the dizzying heights of the §HShroud§!, we reached the intangible summit. The §H$code_name_mountain$§! itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.\n\nA towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.\n\nYet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.\n\n$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$ rises in our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4128`

## shroud.4085.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4085.a&lang=en)

### 中文

山峦还会生长。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3429`

### English

The mountain will grow.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4129`

## shroud.4090.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4090.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]\n\n一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。\n\n随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个§H$code_name_dream$§!越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。\n\n这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3430`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]\n\nA comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.\n\nSinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a §H$code_name_dream$§! drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.\n\nIts slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4131`

## shroud.4095.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4095.title&lang=en)

$the_golden_dream_article_cap$显形

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3431`

### English

## shroud.4095.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4095.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们躺入了§H虚境§!中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了§H$code_name_dream$§!鎏金的大堂。\n\n丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。\n\n$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$给予我们超出理解的奢华。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3432`

### English

As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the §HShroud§!, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the §H$code_name_dream$§!.\n\nSilken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.\n\n$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$ offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4133`

## shroud.4095.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4095.a&lang=en)

梦醒来了。

### English

The dream awakens.

## shroud.4100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]\n\n虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。\n\n在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个§H$code_name_point$§!正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。\n\n祂的平静召唤着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3434`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]\n\nThe Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.\n\nAs we observe, we become aware of an §H$code_name_point$§! orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.\n\nIts calmness beckons us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4136`

## shroud.4105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了§H$code_name_point$§!真正的拥抱。\n\n在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。\n\n在这一切中，我们感受到了$the_hollow_point_color_article$的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3436`

### English

Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the §H$code_name_point$§!.\n\nImages played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.\n\nAmid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of $the_hollow_point_color_article$. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4138`

## shroud.4105.desc.outro_homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4105.desc.outro_homicidal&lang=en)

尽管我们有最基本的本能，但我们的思想已经暴露在了一种奇怪的思维方式之下。

### English

Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.

## shroud.4110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]\n\n混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。\n\n对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。§H$code_name_throne$§!裁决着我们的意图。\n\n它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3440`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]\n\nChaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.\n\nThe heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The §H$code_name_throne$§! judges our intent.\n\nIts gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4143`

## shroud.4115.title

$the_vacant_throne_article_cap$显形

### English

## shroud.4115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们跪伏在§H$code_name_throne$§!前。\n\n我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。\n\n$the_vacant_throne_color_article$高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。\n\n我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3442`

### English

We have knelt in the presence of the §H$code_name_throne$§!.\n\nOur minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.\n\nThe oppressive vacuum of $the_vacant_throne_color_article$ offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.\n\nWe now carry this weight with us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4145`

### English

## shroud.4120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]\n\n我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。\n\n一个实体与我们同行。这条§H$code_name_river$§!在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。\n\n我们必须跟上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3444`

### English

[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]\n\nA sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.\n\nAn entity moves in tandem with us. This §H$code_name_river$§! lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.\n\nWe must follow it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4148`

## shroud.4125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

只有当我们强行超越§H虚境§!的舒适极限时才终于接触到了§H$code_name_river$§!。\n\n一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。\n\n我们终于理解了$the_black_river_color_article$和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3446`

### English

Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the §HShroud§! could we finally reach the §H$code_name_river$§!.\n\nA sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.\n\nFinally we understood $the_black_river_color_article$ and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4150`

## shroud.4135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。\n\n祂是$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：§R“时机未到。”§!缓了一下后。§R“但并非不可。”§!\n\n祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。\n\n§R只要我们能带向终末。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3449`

### English

Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.\n\nIt is $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: §R\"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME.\"§! A pause. §R\"BUT IT COULD BE.\"§!\n\nNothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.\n\n§RIf we will only bring forth the End.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4154`

## shroud.4140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的命运与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。\n\n只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3459`

### English

Our fate is bound to $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.\n\nShould we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4165`

## shroud.4150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。\n\n如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3474`

### English

Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.\n\nIf we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4182`

## shroud.11225.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11225.title&lang=en)

### 中文

突然失踪

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3579`

### English

A Sudden Disappearance

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4305`

## shroud.11225.desc.common_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11225.desc.common_1&lang=en)

### 中文

一切转瞬即逝。\n\n在我们国土内邪恶的§R$end_aura$§!突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3580`

### English

In an instant, it was all gone.\n\nThe malevolent §R$end_aura$§! present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4306`

## shroud.11225.desc.common_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11225.desc.common_2&lang=en)

### 中文

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3581`

### English

Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4307`

## shroud.11225.desc.mitigated

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11225.desc.mitigated&lang=en)

$shroud.11225.desc.common_1$似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。\n\n$shroud.11225.desc.common_2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3586`

### English

$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4313`

## RECKONING_ARRIVAL_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARECKONING_ARRIVAL_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

整个星系受到了一个具有无比强大力量的实体的威胁，它被称为§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!。它由纯能量构成，突然显现以来开始了一趟破坏之旅。\n\n所有数据都表明该物体与我们之前见过的一切事物都截然不同。如果我们想应对这个威胁，就必须进行紧急研究来弄明白到底应该如何与之一战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3594`

### English

The galaxy is under threat from an immensely powerful entity known as the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!. Composed of pure energy, it materialized suddenly and began a campaign of destruction.\n\nAll available data indicate that this being is an opponent unlike anything we have faced before. If we wish to confront this threat, we should execute emergency research to determine more effective methods of engagement.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4322`

## shroud.11235.title

### English

## shroud.11235.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11235.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的[GetScientistPlural]完成了对称为§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!的强大实体的全面研究。\n\n基于目前发现，我们确定出了以现有科技面对该敌手的方法；用于击穿能量护盾的武器稍加改造即可用于削弱构成$NAME_Reckoning$的能量。\n\n尽管它非常强大，但我们现在面对该威胁时也不是毫无希望了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3596`

### English

Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!.\n\nBased on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the $NAME_Reckoning$ can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.\n\nThough it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4325`

## RECKONING_VULNERABILITY_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARECKONING_VULNERABILITY_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们没能成功，但直面§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!也给我们的研究带来了宝贵的数据。\n\n将研究精力投入到该神秘能量生物上，我们就能找到它的弱点，从而发展出更有效的攻击手段。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3599`

### English

Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! provided invaluable data for study.\n\nBy dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop more effective methods of attack.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4329`

## shroud.11240.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11240.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。\n\n初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3601`

### English

The §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.\n\nPreliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4332`

## shroud.4505.desc.individual_machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4505.desc.individual_machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4505.desc.intro$\n\n我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。\n\n$shroud.4505.desc.outro$

### English

## shroud.4505.desc_2_pacifist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4505.desc_2_pacifist&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的社会已经开始发生变化。我们的思想与战争的欲望相冲突。这种认知失调在素来和平的人群中引起了极大的不适。我们选择对了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3642`

### English

Changes in our society are already emerging. Our minds are in conflict with a taste for battle. This cognitive dissonance is causing great discomfort among our normally peaceful population. Have we made the right choice?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4379`

## shroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一位名为$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着贪婪的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3653`

### English

We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$. Insatiable, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4392`

## shroud.4550.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4550.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的意识中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。\n\n代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。\n\n§H只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。§!\n\n它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3661`

### English

As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.\n\nThe cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.\n\n§HIf we will only accept it into our hearts.§!\n\nIt is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4402`

### 中文

$shroud.4555.desc.intro$\n\n这笔买卖的代价很明显了。我们等待着繁荣富饶的黄金时代到来，大众也不再满足于生存的必须。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在渴望各种各样的物质财富——这是我们新的经济负担。\n\n$shroud.4555.desc.outro$

## shroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一个名为§H渴求之器具§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3677`

### English

We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Pampering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4421`

## shroud.4600.desc_homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4600.desc_homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们沉入虚境，一个存在开始炙烤我们的内心幻景。弥漫的光芒笼罩了一切。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$正在灼烧着我们的内心。\n\n它要求的不只是星系尺度的妥协、劣等异种之间的卑鄙和平。祂向我们许诺伟大的力量，只要我们肯接受这种可憎的愿景。\n\n§H只要我们任其塑造新的视野。§!\n\n月窠的光芒不屈不挠，祂的力量不可抵抗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3689`

### English

As we sink into the Shroud, a presence sears our inner vision. The pervading glow obscures all else. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it burns within our core.\n\nIt demands no less than compromise on a galactic scale, an abject peace of incompatible beings. Great power awaits us, it promises, if we accept this detestable vision.\n\n§HIf only we will let it shape new horizons.§!\n\nThe Cradle's light is relentless, and its power is undeniable. Could our minds ever embrace such a thing? Will it weaken our resolve?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4435`

## shroud.4600.desc_non_homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4600.desc_non_homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们的心智沉入虚境，一个存在在我们的内心开始绽放。我们感受到了它的光芒点亮了一切，释放出秩序和平衡。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$，正在触动着我们的最深处。\n\n祂想要的不仅仅是持久的和平——而是让星系摆脱混沌。如果我们共享祂的愿景，就可以使我们成为和谐的使者。祂承诺了牢不可破的信任。\n\n§H只要我们任其塑造新的视野。§!\n\n月窠的期望重重地落在我们身上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3690`

### English

As our minds sink into the Shroud, a presence blooms within us. We sense a glow that touches all things, radiating order and balance. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it stirs us to our core.\n\nIt wants no less than enduring peace - a galaxy cured of its chaos. If we share its vision, it can forge us into bringers of harmony. It promises a bond of unbreakable trust.\n\n§HIf only we will let it shape our horizons.§!\n\nThe hopes of the Cradle press upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4436`
