## shroud.4605.desc_outro_homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4605.desc_outro_homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经无可否认。许多[Root.GetIndividualPlural]的思想被所谓的星系和平所荼毒，在我们社会中产生了深刻的认知失调。\n\n据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，交易的庇佑还没到来。而我们必须忍受这种可怕的思想冲突的困扰直到它到来为止。我们究竟对自己做了什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3699`

### English

The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already undeniable. The minds of many [Root.GetIndividualPlural] are poisoned by thoughts of galactic peace, causing profound dissonance throughout our society.\n\nAccording to our [GetTelepathPlural], the blessings of this bargain are yet to come. Until that time, a terrible conflict plagues our minds. What is it that we have done to ourselves?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4446`

## shroud.4605.desc_outro_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4605.desc_outro_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经可以探测。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对集体意识产生干扰。\n\n这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3700`

### English

The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already detectable. As we aim for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes disturbance in the collective consciousness.\n\nThis small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4447`

## shroud.4605.desc_outro_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4605.desc_outro_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经显而易见。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对大众造成痛苦。\n\n这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3701`

### English

The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already apparent. As we yearn for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes distress throughout the populace.\n\nThis small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4448`

## shroud_cradle_covenant_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_cradle_covenant_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一位名为$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着和谐的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。\n\n月窠渴求着星系摆脱混沌和冲突，所有住民都致力于实现同一个和平。只有完美的平衡才足够。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3710`

### English

We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$. Harmonious, it grants us crumbs of power for a price.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.\n\nThe Cradle aches for a galaxy free from chaos and conflict, with all its denizens bent towards the unifying goal of peace. Only perfect balance will suffice.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4459`

## shroud.4650.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4650.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的思维中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。\n\n这个存在即是$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以生长、变化、改进、演化的方向。\n\n§H只要我们愿意将其纳入肉身。§!\n\n祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3717`

### English

A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.\n\nThis presence, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.\n\n§HIf we will only take it into our flesh.§!\n\nIt waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4468`

## shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一位名为$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3733`

### English

We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4487`

## shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc

## shroud.4705.desc.outro

### 中文

## shroud.4705.desc.gestalt

### 中文

$shroud.4705.desc.intro$随着我们的集体等待着隐秘知识的汇入，我们感觉到了自己的思想分支成了不同的模式。[GetNetworkName]的稳态和谐被内心越来越不统一的声音所覆盖。\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4504`

## shroud.4705.desc.non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4705.desc.non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4705.desc.intro$随着我们的渴望着隐秘知识的汇入，我们社会中的理念和观点已经变得分歧重重。不和谐的声音损伤着心神，妨害了所有[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的精神健康。\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3748`

### English

$shroud.4705.desc.intro$ As we thirst for hidden knowledge, the ideas and opinions within our society have grown more divergent. A discord of inner voices abrades our psyches, threatening the mental wellbeing of all [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4505`

## shroud.4715.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4715.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

完成了。我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：§R“时日已到。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3761`

### English

It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: §R\"THE END BEGINS.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4520`

## shroud.4715.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4715.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4715.desc.intro$\n\n接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经§H虚境§!的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。\n\n我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3762`

### English

$shroud.4715.desc.intro$\n\nThen, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the §HShroud§! roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.\n\nWe were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4521`

## shroud.4715.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4715.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4715.desc.intro$\n\n接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经§H虚境§!的众多能量在[GetBrainName]之中翻滚，而灵能界现在静滞得如同不存在了一样。\n\n我们不得不开始估算自己给自己带来的后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3763`

### English

$shroud.4715.desc.intro$\n\nThen, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the §HShroud§! roiled throughout the [GetBrainName], the psionic realm is now inert as nonbeing.\n\nWe were left to estimate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4522`

## shroud_whisperers_covenant_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_whisperers_covenant_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与一位名为$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价承诺赐予我们零星力量。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。\n\n低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3769`

### English

We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$. Unfathomable, it promises to grant us crumbs of power for a price.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.\n\nThe Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4529`

## shroud.11120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出§H虚境§!，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。\n\n§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!附近出现了一道$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:3785`

### English

As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the §HShroud§!, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].\n\nA $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ has emerged near §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!, which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4548`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.11120.a&lang=en)

### English

The End Has Come

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4854`

## shroud.4970.desc.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4970.desc.1&lang=en)

### 中文

不同维度之间的帷幕短暂消失了，虚境的灵能力突然被一整个驱逐到可接触现实中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4047`

### English

The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4855`

## shroud.4970.desc.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4970.desc.2&lang=en)

### 中文

所有的有意识众生，无论是生物还是机械体都被抹除了。所有的行星都变成了荒芜的空壳。即便恒星也熄灭了最后一道光芒。\n\n尽管如此，在最后一刻，我们所能感受到的只是脑海中的一个心声……\n\n§R“此为万终之末。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4048`

### English

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.\n\nDespite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...\n\n§R\"THE END OF ENDS.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4856`

## shroud.4970.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4970.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$降临了。\n\n$end_aura$吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。$shroud.4970.desc.1$\n\n$shroud.4970.desc.2$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4049`

### English

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ is upon us.\n\nThe $end_aura$ has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.$shroud.4970.desc.1$\n\n$shroud.4970.desc.2$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4857`

## shroud.4190.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4190.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4079`

### English

Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4895`

## shroud.4190.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4190.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4190.desc.intro$这种称为§H“$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$”§!的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。\n\n这种光环现在也在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4080`

### English

$shroud.4190.desc.intro$ Termed §H'$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$'§!, on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.\n\nSuch an Aura has now been detected in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4896`

## shroud.4190.desc_mindwarden

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4190.desc_mindwarden&lang=en)

### 中文

关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!或许知道如何反制其效果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4081`

### English

If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! may know methods of counteracting its effects.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4897`

## shroud.4205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4205.common$\n\n我们的使命是保护大家免受§H虚境§!以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。\n\n我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4100`

### English

$shroud.4205.common$\n\nOur mission is to protect against the menace of the §HShroud§! and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.\n\nJudging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4919`

## shroud.4205.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4205.desc.end&lang=en)

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H$zro_lower$§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。

### English

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §H$zro_lower$§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4920`

## shroud.4205.desc.return

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4205.desc.return&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4102`

### English

Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.\n\nOur psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the §HShroud§!. Good, good...\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.end$

## shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_combating_the_shroud&lang=en)

### 中文

从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。\n\n如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H$zro_lower$§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4120`

### English

From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§! and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.\n\nShould you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from §H$zro_lower$§! disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4940`

## shroud.4210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚境§!可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的§H“灵能”§!能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。\n\n虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。\n\n为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4121`

### English

The §HShroud§! can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful §H'psionic'§! energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.\n\nThe Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.\n\nEnsuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4942`

## shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_text_shroud_seal&lang=en)

### 中文

这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解$PSIONIC_AURA$，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4122`

### English

These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any $PSIONIC_AURA$ until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4944`

## shroud.4230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

抑制§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!主要有两种方法。\n\n在行星上建造§H$building_psionic_suppressor$§!可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。\n\n更强大的解决方法是§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4123`

### English

There are two principal methods of suppressing §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.\n\nBuilding a §H$building_psionic_suppressor$§! on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.\n\nAn even more powerful solution is a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4945`

## shroud.4240.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4240.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……\n\n有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。\n\n如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4129`

### English

Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...\n\nA targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.\n\nLet us know the target, if you agree.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4952`

## shroud.4250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

棒极了。把$zro_lower$委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。\n\n这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4151`

### English

Excellent. Entrusting us with $zro_lower$ enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.\n\nThis is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4977`

## shroud.4251.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4251.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$sr_zro$§!是一种高度不稳定的稀有物质，它的具体效用难以控制和预测。无论是有意或是无意，它可能引发剧烈的能量爆炸，造成大规模破坏。\n\n这些性质是通过一种与§H虚境§!的反应产生的，这使其在灵能实践者中非常受欢迎——有些人甚至把这东西当成药来磕。\n\n我们希望能进一步研究$zro_lower$，找出安全处置的方法；这也是我们对回购泽珞出手如此阔绰的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4157`

### English

§Y$sr_zro$§! is a rare, highly unstable substance, the effects of which are difficult to control and predict. Intentionally or not, it can cause violent bursts of energy that wreak destruction on a mass scale.\n\nThese properties are produced through reactions with the §HShroud§!, making it popular among psionic practitioners - some of whom ingest it as a drug.\n\nWe aim to learn more about $zro_lower$ and to research methods for its safe disposal; that is why we pay handsomely for any quantity brought to us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4983`

## shroud.4255.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4255.desc&lang=en)

感谢你的贡献。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4158`

### English

Thank you for your contribution.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4984`

## shroud.4260.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4260.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

那就让我们来提供一些有用的§Y$decision_thought_police$§!，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。\n\n他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用§H虚境§!的危险能量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4159`

### English

Then let us provide you with an effective §Y$decision_thought_police$§!, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.\n\nTheir methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4986`

## shroud.4265.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4265.desc&lang=en)

Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.\n\nWe mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:4993`

## mindwarden_farewell

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amindwarden_farewell&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“你最近对$gov_mindwarden_enclave$的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4191`

### English

§L\"Your recent attack upon a $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5024`

## shroud.4290.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4290.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

根据我们的情报，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$是一种来自§H虚境§!内的灾害性的力量。它的力量可以通过一些渴望力量的心灵入侵者同谋在物理现实中显现。\n\n终末通过§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!给星系带来毁灭——那是一种由纯灵能构成的邪恶实体。它的终极目标就是完全抹杀本现实的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4197`

### English

According to our intelligence, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ is a cataclysmic force from within the §HShroud§!. Its power can manifest in physical reality through the complicity of power-hungry mind-invaders.\n\nThe End inflicts ruin upon the galaxy through the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! - a vicious being composed of psionic energy. Its ultimate goal is the complete annihilation of this existence.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5031`

## shroud.4291.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4291.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4200`

### English

May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5034`

## shroud.4292.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4292.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。\n\n在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4201`

### English

We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.\n\nIn its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5035`

## shroud.4295.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4295.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4205.common$\n\n我们最初对与你们“$building_materiality_engine_plural$”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓§H“虚境”§!的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。\n\n我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4203`

### English

$shroud.4205.common$\n\nWe were initially concerned by reports of your '$building_materiality_engine_plural$'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called §H'Shroud'§!.\n\nWe encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5038`

## shroud.4300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。\n\n根据我们灵能传感器的读数，整个[Root.GetName]已经无可挽回地被§H虚境§!玷污了。\n\n你们的所作所为是在自掘坟墓——我们不介意帮你们一铲子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4205`

### English

I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].\n\nJudging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the §HShroud§!.\n\nYour actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5041`

## shroud.4300.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4300.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为什么这么害怕虚境？

### English

Why do you fear the Shroud?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5042`

## shroud.4310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不害怕虚境，更不害怕它的走狗，因为我们知道如何对付这些东西。\n\n我不指望你们——这被虚境影响得失心疯了的社会——理解一丝一毫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4207`

### English

We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.\n\nI would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5044`

## shroud.4320.desc.psionic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4320.desc.psionic&lang=en)

### 中文

难道用灵能荼毒星系还不够吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4208`

### English

Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5046`

## shroud.4320.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4320.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是维护星系秩序的力量；攻击我们有什么好处？我们不会坐视你的好战行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4209`

### English

We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5047`

## shroud.4320.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4320.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

在你们确认无条件停止敌对行为之前，我们没什么可谈的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4210`

### English

Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5048`

## shroud.4340.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4340.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们知道你们和§H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!的那些交易。你们这种行为不仅是在纵容他们的错误，更是在帮助§H虚境§!感染传播。\n\n只要你们还在与他们合作，我们就不会提供任何服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4211`

### English

We are aware of your dealings with the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the §HShroud§!.\n\nWe will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5050`

## shroud.4350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H在他们的设施遭到摧毁后，我们至今无法与[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]再次取得联系。\n\n打开他们的通讯频道，我们只能听到宇宙的虚空寂静。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4212`

### English

§HWe have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.\n\nWhen we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5052`

## shroud.4405.desc.default

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4405.desc.default&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4405.desc_common$尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对§H“虚境”§!的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4218`

### English

$shroud.4405.desc_common$ Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the §H'Shroud'§! represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5060`

## shroud.4405.desc.psionic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.4405.desc.psionic&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.4405.desc_common$他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓§H虚境§!危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4219`

### English

$shroud.4405.desc_common$ They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the §HShroud§!, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5061`

## shroud.4405.desc_end

我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。

我们获悉[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!不复存在了。该$gov_mindwarden_enclave$无法抵御§H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!的猛烈攻击，他们的空间站化作碎片，没有找到任何幸存者。

This $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ was unable to withstand an onslaught by the §H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!, which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.

## shroud.6860.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4237`

### English

With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5082`

## shroud.6860.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们必须对诡计多端的灵能威胁保持警惕。您的慷慨捐赠将使我们能够大大扩大业务规模以应对这种挑战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4238`

### English

We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5083`

## shroud.6860.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已取得了诸多成就，但现在休息还为时尚早。只要能支配更多资源，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队就能在星系中部署得更远，守护更多被灵能所困扰的心灵。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4239`

### English

We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5084`

## shroud.6860.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帮助我们踏上旅程的正是您提供的启动资金，而我们的目标仍然是一样的：通过彻底根除灵能来促进心灵健康。有了您的帮助，我们离目标越来越近了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4240`

### English

Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5085`

## shroud.6860.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果您认为值得再次投资我们的行动，我们就将成为星系中最大的反灵能军——群星间所有国家抵抗精神入侵的最高堡垒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4241`

### English

If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5086`

## shroud.6860.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6860.b&lang=en)

### 中文

那我们就成交吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4242`

### English

We have a deal, then.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5087`

## shroud.6861.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6861.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4243`

### English

Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5089`

## shroud.6865.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6865.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一项伟大的事业。星系中$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。\n\n我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4244`

### English

A fine undertaking. The more $ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$ there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.\n\nWe can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5091`

## shroud.6865.b.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6865.b.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

$mindwarden_enclave_capacity$：§G+1§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4245`

### English

$mindwarden_enclave_capacity$: §G+1§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5092`

## shroud.6870.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6870.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4246`

### English

We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5094`

## shroud.6875.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6875.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4247`

### English

We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5096`

## mindwarden_tt_hirefleet

## shroud.6876.desc

### 中文

我们相信§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4249`

### English

We trust that the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5099`

## mindwarden_tt_managefleet

## shroud.6880.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6880.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

确实。我们希望§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？

## origin_mindwardens_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_mindwardens_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§R警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。§!\n\n这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。\n\n他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4258`

### English

$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.\n\nTheir ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5111`

## origin_tooltip_mindwardens_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_tooltip_mindwardens_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

—$ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$£engineering£['technology:tech_starbase_3']\n—$HOME_SYSTEM$初始拥有§H$tech_starbase_3$§!。\n—$HOMEWORLD$£building£['building:building_ancient_ward_1']\n—可以对灵能飞升帝国使用§Y$casus_belli_cb_psionics_containment$§!§H宣战理由§!。\n—§Y$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§!不会出现。\n—§Y$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$§!不会在游戏开始时生成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4259`

### English

- $ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$ £engineering£ ['technology:tech_starbase_3']\n- $HOME_SYSTEM$ Start with a §H$tech_starbase_3$§!.\n- $HOMEWORLD$ £building£ ['building:building_ancient_ward_1']\n- Gain access to the §Y$casus_belli_cb_psionics_containment$§! §HCasus Belli§! against psionically ascended Empires.\n- §Y$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§! do not appear.\n- §Y$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$§! are not generated at the start of game.

## START_SCREEN_MINDWARDENS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_MINDWARDENS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们先祖留下来的记录讲述了一场摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]的灵能瘟疫。超自然的力量攻击心智，毁灭性的辐射散布在大气中——而这都是[GetSpeciesAdj]社会中的灵能尝试引起的。\n\n为了应对这些威胁，先祖们建造了$building_ancient_ward_1$来抵御入侵心智的力量。仅依靠日常维护，这座古老的建筑就已经强大到足以保护所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]免受灵能干扰的威胁，它的核心技术也为其他心灵防御的发展提供了信息。\n\n随着我们的文明准备扬帆越过[capital_scope.System.GetName]的轨道，等待我们的只有未知。在我们陌生的世界里又有什么样的灵能威胁在等待着我们呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4261`

### English

The records of our ancestors tell of a psychic plague that once devastated [GetHomeWorldName]. Otherworldly forces attacked their minds, and destructive radiation was diffused throughout the atmosphere - all encouraged by psionic practitioners from within [GetSpeciesAdj] society.\n\nIn response to these threats, our ancestors built the $building_ancient_ward_1$ to protect against mind-invading forces. With only routine maintenance, this venerable structure has proven strong enough to defend all [GetSpeciesNamePlural] from the threat of psionic influence, and its core technology has informed the development of other defenses of the mind.\n\nAs our civilization prepares to voyage beyond the orbit of [capital_scope.System.GetName], we are faced with the unknown. What psychic threats might lurk beyond our ken?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5115`

## shroud.6050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们用于压制灵能的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!正在发出异常的读数。这通常是来自[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的灵能活动激增的结果，但我们并没有找到任何这种堕落行为的迹象。\n\n那么答案也许就藏在我们的国境内。长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与$building_ancient_ward_1$发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4302`

### English

Our psi-suppressive §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.\n\nThe answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the $building_ancient_ward_1$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5163`

## shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms

### 中文

情绪波动；令人衰弱的精神压力；反复出现难以形容的恐怖景象

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4304`

### English

emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror

## shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_text_psi_radiation&lang=en)

### 中文

这些现象与我们祖先记录的体验非常相符；非常有可能就是他们所说的“灵能辐射”，一种极具破坏力的能量发射形式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4305`

### English

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5167`

## shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction&lang=en)

### 中文

舰队的系统也受到严重故障的困扰，妨碍了多数正常的功能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4306`

### English

The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5168`

### English

Dangerous Energy

## shroud.6100.desc.no_border_aura

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6100.desc.no_border_aura&lang=en)

### 中文

新探索到的§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。[root.GetName]的船员遭受到了一系列精神症状：$shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$。他们的舰队系统也发生了怪异的故障。\n\n$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$在§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!的保护不到的§H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上，我们第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。\n\n在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。$shroud.6100.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4308`

### English

An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored §H[from.GetName]§! system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: $shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.\n\n$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$ Outside of the protection of the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!, we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.\n\nAfter calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5171`

## shroud.6100.desc.border_aura

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6100.desc.border_aura&lang=en)

### 中文

[root.GetName]的船员们岌岌可危。\n\n在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系里暴露到这种极高等级的灵能辐射后，他们开始产生比此前报道的更糟糕的精神压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$\n\n长程扫描表明有更高等级的辐射在从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系中释放出来。$shroud.6100.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4309`

### English

The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.\n\nUpon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$\n\nLong-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5172`

## shroud.6110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

出乎意料的是，§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在许多似乎是由智慧生物所建造的大型物体。我们为了了解其创造者，将其代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，并尝试在保持安全距离的前提下进行直接的沟通工作。\n\n该恒星系内所有的生命形式必然都处在我们探测到的高水平灵能辐射的威胁下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4313`

### English

Astonishingly, the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.\n\nAny life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5177`

We have discovered possible evidence of alien intelligence in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system.

## shroud.6115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

进一步的研究确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中的物体是一艘外星飞船，但我们还未与任何船上人员建立任何沟通渠道。\n\n特使[exiled_envoy.GetName]汇报[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的团队开始遭受到超心灵学症状的困扰，包括[This.System.GetName]上出现奇特生物的无法解释的幻象。尽管有这些问题，我们的特使还是坚持投入[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的这项任务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4316`

### English

Further study has confirmed the objects in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.\n\nTroublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5181`

## shroud.6120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在数个月的寂静后，我们收到了一份来自[exiled_envoy.GetName]的通讯。这位通常冷静而直率的特使发来了一份离奇而混乱的报告。[exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap]杂乱无章地描述了一些奇怪的意象——显然是纠缠在一起的梦境和幻觉。[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]团队的所有人也都一样神志不清。\n\n目前他们已经解除了职务，该任务也无限期搁置了。无论§H[This.System.GetName]§!里的到底是什么东西，目前我们都暂时没有办法安全地调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4320`

### English

After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.\n\nThey have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in §H[This.System.GetName]§!, it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5186`

## fcsum_exiled_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afcsum_exiled_3&lang=en)

### 中文

在这场令人痛苦的任务之后，我们的团队在没有与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!达成联络便启程回家了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4321`

### English

Following a traumatic mission, our team has returned home before making contact with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5187`

## shroud.6125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

悬浮在翻滚的水流之上。是§H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!，还是……？\n\n§H……呼叫……§!\n\n水面扭转着分开。恶臭的瘴气从无底的深处喷涌而出。\n\n§H……回复……没有……§!\n\n无休无止。令人窒息。\n\n这太糟糕了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4322`

### English

Suspended above the roiling current. §H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!, or...?\n\n§H...calling...§!\n\nThe surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.\n\n§H...answer...nothing...§!\n\nCeaseless. Suffocating.\n\nIt is terrible.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5189`

## shroud.shared_text_aura_spread

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_text_aura_spread&lang=en)

### 中文

近处的灵能“感染”已经传播进了§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系中。\n\n尽管有§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!提供保护，这种侵蚀导致我们在§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的人口也开始表现出可能与灵能辐射荼毒有关的一些症状了。预测显示，这种心灵瘟疫可能很快会传播至§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!，我们的母星也会因此受到进一步的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4324`

### English

The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.\n\nDespite the protections offered by the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!, this encroachment has caused our population on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!, where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5193`

## shroud.shared_text_aura_study

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_text_aura_study&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4325`

### English

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5194`

## shroud.6200.a

## shroud.6205.desc.start

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6205.desc.start&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究者们在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。\n\n我们将这种危险的现象归类为§H“$PSIONIC_AURA$”§!，这是一种巨大破坏性能量的积聚体，它不仅会扰乱我们的思想，也能干扰我们的技术装备。它是从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系传播而出，那里的灵能能量增长到能够跨越恒星系进行传播的强度了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4334`

### English

Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, but their mission led to important findings.\n\nWe have classified this alarming phenomenon as a §H'$PSIONIC_AURA$'§!, a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5206`

## PSIONIC_AURA_RESISTANCE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APSIONIC_AURA_RESISTANCE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们祖先建造在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!是用来保护我们不受灵能辐射伤害的。§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的入侵大大超出了它的防护能力。如果用上目前为止所学到的知识，我们应该就有能力提升其防御性能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4340`

### English

The §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! built by our ancestors on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what we have learned so far, we should be able to enhance its resistant properties.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5213`

## shroud.6210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们孜孜不倦的研究者们开发出了一种增强§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!的方法。通过改进灵能衰减器，它的防护效果不仅可以覆盖到整颗行星，还能保护§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!系。\n\n这项研究激发了在该失落的科技领域内更广泛的研究。我们现在知道灵能辐射和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]意识之间存在着相互联系：不止是这种能量发射可以影响我们的精神状态，我们的精神状态也同样能影响灵能辐射等级。看来我们对“灵能”实践的古老禁忌是有科学依据的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4342`

### English

Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system.\n\nThis research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5216`

## ancient_ward_upgrade_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aancient_ward_upgrade_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!已经到功能的极限了。为了应对附近的灵能威胁，很有必要进一步提升它的性能。这种新的§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!应该可以保护我们的人口不受§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!侵染。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4346`

### English

The §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! has reached its functional limits. In order to deal with the nearby psionic threat, it will be necessary to enhance its capacities even further. This new §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! shall be capable of protecting our population against the blight of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5221`

## shroud.6215.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6215.desc.end&lang=en)

### 中文

无论如何，这个§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!以及可能存在着的其他同类都依旧在荼毒着这个恒星系。我们的科学家认为，$building_ancient_ward_2$的科技可以用于开发更强大的§H“$SHROUD_SEAL$”§!。这些硕大无比的装置可以抑制一整个星团的光环。在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系建造一个$SHROUD_SEAL$将能大幅度提升控制灵能威胁的能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4351`

### English

Nevertheless, this §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ could be applied to the development of a more powerful §H'$SHROUD_SEAL$'§!. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5227`

## build_shroud_seal_poi_desc

在完成§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技的研究后，我们就能用$constructor$在恒星引力井内建造§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!了。这种装置可以抑制整个恒星系以及通过超空间航道毗邻的其他恒星系内的§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4353`

### English

After researching §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! technology, we can use a $constructor$ to build a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! within a stellar gravity well. This will suppress §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! throughout the star system and adjacent systems connected via a hyperlane.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5230`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6231.desc&lang=en)

### English

## shroud.6300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的科学家们完成了对先进§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技的研发。现在可以在我们控制的任何一个殖民地内建造$building_psionic_suppressor$来复现$building_ancient_ward_2$的效果了。\n\n然而，要在其他恒星系内控制§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的传播，我们还需要建造一种被称为§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!的更加强大的装置。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$\n\n这项研究也证实了一个令人不安的理论：存在着一个被称为§H“虚境”§!的空灵领域！古代神秘文献中描述的那种灵能维度很有可能是真的。该理论认为，感性众生的认知活动可以使能量从虚境内传递到可观察现实中——这种过程就是$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的一般性来源。\n\n这意味着我们不仅仅只是在与宇宙的客观力量作斗争，而是与某种潜在的未知意图的可疑行为对抗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4382`

### English

Our scientists have completed the development of advanced §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! technology. We can now replicate the effects of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ on any colony under our control by building a $building_psionic_suppressor$.\n\nHowever, to control the spread of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$\n\nThis research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the §H'Shroud'§!, a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ in general.\n\nThis means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5266`

## shroud.shared_screen_figure

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_screen_figure&lang=en)

### 中文

§H屏幕上的人物以一种稳定、催眠的节奏与人交流，不时会作很长时间的停顿。§!\n\n遥远的邻居们，鉴于你们对直接接触不予回应，我们只好诉诸于粗糙的技术通信。\n\n我是§H乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特§!，§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的灵主。事态很紧急；原谅我的仓促。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4386`

### English

§HThe figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.§!\n\nFar neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.\n\nI am §HUk-Hogolath Scarat§!, Psiarch of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5272`

is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.\n\nThe aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called

## shroud.6550.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6550.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了避免与§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!发生直接冲突，我们默认了他们对拆解§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内$SHROUD_SEAL$的要求。\n\n与那些散布灵能瘟疫的家伙们的接触已经在§H[this.GetName]§!引起了严重关切。移除$SHROUD_SEAL$似乎也只能是一种暂时的绥靖政策。他们很定还会想要对我们的§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!做一样的事情的——这就是我们绝对不能接受的事情。\n\n无论如何，一战在所难免。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4404`

### English

In order to avoid immediate conflict with the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.\n\nExposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the §H[this.GetName]§!. Removal of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ is only likely to be a short term appeasement. They will eventually expect the same of our §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! - and that is something we cannot accept.\n\nIn any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5293`

### 中文

§H灵主的图像一出现，便开始冷漠地、无声地指责。§!\n\n[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我很失望还要打这通通讯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4409`

### English

§HAs soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.§!\n\n[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission.

## shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain&lang=en)

### 中文

你们用行为证明了自己有多无知。你们对我们的光环流横加阻挠，对整个灵能事业无端蔑视，这都与整个跨星系的和平水火不容。我们别无选择。\n\n等着见我们的舰队吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4410`

### English

Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.\n\nBe prepared to meet our fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5301`

### English

Sealing §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5311`

## shroud.6580.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6580.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着巨大的灵能衰减器闪耀着启动，我们的§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!开始逐渐将§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!驱赶出§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。\n\n跨星系扫描确认了帝国领土的其他部分都直接通过超空间航道连接到[exiled_center_system.GetName]。只需要一座$SHROUD_SEAL$就能打消整个§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!境内的$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$。\n\n我们胜利的关键就在于保护封印了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4418`

### English

With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! is now in the process of driving out the §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nInterstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single $SHROUD_SEAL$ is therefore capable of dissipating $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ throughout the entire territory of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.\n\nOur victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5312`

### English

### 中文

灵道会

### English

The Assembly of Mindways

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5315`

## shroud.6600.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6600.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们征服了§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上造成灵能威胁的殖民地。\n\n我们了解到在该恒星系内出现的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!受到了人口与§H虚境§!的心灵交互的增强。这些举措是由一群称为§H灵道会§!的精英灵能者们领导的。这个灵能邪教在宣导他们对所谓“超主”的忠诚，而这超主据称是虚境内一个强大实体，我们仅知道其被称为§H$r_the_lost_patron$§!。\n\n他们的经文反复提到与这个存在有关的灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。找到这个东西就可以帮助我们阻止他们继续传播影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4421`

### English

The colony of the psionic menace on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! has been conquered.\n\nWe have learned that the §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the §HAssembly of Mindways§!. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as §H$r_the_lost_patron$§!.\n\nTheir sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5316`

[current_planet.GetName]上的废墟

### English

Ruins on [current_planet.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5319`

## shroud.6601.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6601.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们完成了对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的殖民，这曾是一颗[exiled_country.GetName]的行星。\n\n从他们残留的记录中我了解到，该恒星系内此前存在的$PSIONIC_AURA$是由人口和§H虚境§!的心灵互动造成的。带领这种行为的灵能邪教鼓吹诡异所谓的“超主”，据说是虚境里的一个叫做§H$r_the_lost_patron$§!的强大实体。\n\n他们经文的残片中反复提到与这个存在有关的某件灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。要实现这个目标，就需要更慎重地征服[other_planet.GetName]，留下一部分人口。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4424`

### English

We have completed our colonization of §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].\n\nFrom the remains of their records, we have learned that the $PSIONIC_AURA$ previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as §H$r_the_lost_patron$§!.\n\nFragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5320`

### English

$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$

## shroud.6700.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6700.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已立即对这些星球上的所有灵能活动进行了严厉打击，彻底消除了其可憎的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!。\n\n在该星球的主要城市里，矗立着一座名为§H$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$§!的废弃高塔，它曾是前帝国现已声名狼藉的灵能邪教的至高神殿。我们的士兵形容它散发着一种神圣而令人不安的气息。\n\n该建筑的最深处密室中，有一个密封严密的“茧”，散发出强大的局部灵能辐射。事实证明，标准弹药无法穿透其外部。要消除该物体对我们持续安全构成的潜在威胁，还需要进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4427`

### English

We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!.\n\nIn the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the §H$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$§!, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.\n\nThe innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5324`

对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的征服标志着我们对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的最终胜利。$shroud.6700.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4428`

### English

The conquest of §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked our final victory against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

## shroud.6705.desc.common

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6705.desc.common&lang=en)

### 中文

初步调查显示，该星球上存在一个庞大的建筑网络，很可能是灵能浩劫的力量中心。如今，只剩下残垣断壁。\n\n我们可能永远无法得知这些建筑曾隐藏着怎样堕落的秘密，也无法得知其居住者卑劣行径的真实性质。尽管如此，该星系现已清除其残余的$PSIONIC_AURA$，使我们免受其曾造成的伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4433`

### English

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.\n\nWe may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its $PSIONIC_AURA$, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5331`

## shroud.6705.desc.contact

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6705.desc.contact&lang=en)

### 中文

对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上人口的彻底清除，标志着§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!帝国的终结。\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4434`

### English

The eradication of the population on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked the end of the empire known as the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5332`

## SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$遗迹里，我们找到了一颗被紧紧包裹着的“茧”，它正在散发出极高等级的灵能辐射。我们必须进行现场调查来消除这个物体可能带来的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4440`

### English

Within the ruined $SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$ on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!, we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any threat this object might pose.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5339`

## shroud.6710.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6710.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究者对§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的“茧”进行了全面的分析。\n\n对这座宏伟建筑的外部扫描显示，它是一个专门设计用于容纳强大灵能实体的高规格安全容器。尽管该容器有重合金绝缘层，但高水平的灵能辐射还是透过外壳渗漏了出来。\n\n茧的周围安装有一组灵能衰减器；激活的时候时，周边地区的所有人都受到了严重的神经损伤。\n\n茧的表面随之扭曲，从卵型变成了不断变化的螺旋形。其上的孔穴洞窟，我们接到了来自内部的直接通信……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4442`

### English

Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nExternal scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.\n\nA group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.\n\nThe surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5342`

## shroud.6800.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6800.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经积累了大量关于§H虚境§!的知识，开发出了能抑制其恶劣影响的先进科技。在讨论如何将这种技术大规模应用到全星系的过程中，我们的舰队司令提出了一项有趣的提案。\n\n他们建议将我们的一支舰队设立为一个独立的§H“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”§!，这样就能向全星系的客户提供反灵能服务了。$shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4445`

### English

We have amassed great knowledge of the §HShroud§!, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.\n\nThey suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent §H'$gov_mindwarden_enclave$'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. $shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5347`

## shroud.6830.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6830.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

与§H虚境§!以及灵能滥用的斗争让我们的人民变得更加强大，也更明确了我们的目标。第一座§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!的建立正标志着一个康复和抵抗的新纪元。\n\n在整个星系中，心智不再被灵能侵犯，所有星球都不再受到虚境力量的折磨。\n\n这就是$MINDWARDEN_plural$时代。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4455`

### English

Contending with the §HShroud§! and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§! is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.\n\nThroughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.\n\nIt is now the age of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5359`

## shroud.shared_enclave_investement

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.shared_enclave_investement&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。\n\n我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4457`

### English

Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.\n\nNaturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5362`

## the_psionic_war_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Athe_psionic_war_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的战争迫在眉睫。\n\n这场灵能浩劫必须从根源上解决。我们必须先在§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系内建造一座$SHROUD_SEAL$，以此中和掉$PSIONIC_AURA$；只有这样我们才能踏足，并将其从这个星系里净化掉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4465`

### English

War against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! is now upon us.\n\nThe psionic scourge must be quelled at its source. We must first construct a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, thereby neutralizing the $PSIONIC_AURA$; only then can we move in and purge this menace from this galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5373`

## shroud_seal_reconstruction_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_seal_reconstruction_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拆除§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!是为了安抚§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的必要牺牲，但该举措也只是缓兵之计。如果我们想再次踏足他们的领土并净化§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!就必须把这座建筑重建起来。\n\n§P重建将会视为冒犯行为。我们必须做好一切反扑的准备。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4473`

### English

Dismantling our §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! was a necessary sacrifice to placate the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, but this measure was only a ploy for time. The structure must be rebuilt before we can enter their territory and purge it of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.\n\n§PReconstruction will be seen as an act of aggression. We must be ready for any retaliation.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5382`

## shroud.6770.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6770.name&lang=en)

### 中文

$r_the_lost_patron$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4509`

### English

$r_the_lost_patron$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5433`

## shroud.6770.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.6770.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上发现的茧里寄宿着一个强大的异次元实体。它在某种意义上似乎就是威胁到我们心智健全的$PSIONIC_AURA$的源头。\n\n我们的灵能衰减器暂时减轻了它的危险，但目前还不清楚还能抑制它多久。如果能够妥善控制，我们甚至有可能利用它可怕的力量来实现自己的目的。\n\n然而我们社会的多数人呼吁立即将其摧毁。这种东西光是存在就已经站在我们长久以来价值观的对立面上了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4510`

### English

The cocoon we discovered on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§! harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the $PSIONIC_AURA$ that threatened the sanctity of our minds.\n\nOur psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.\n\nNevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5434`

### 中文

## origin_endbringers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_endbringers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§R警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。§!\n\n该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4545`

### English

$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5478`
