## START_SCREEN_ENDBRINGERS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_ENDBRINGERS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是末日的先锋。\n\n在[GetSpeciesAdj]文明的诞生伊始，一场神秘的灾难就降临在我们的邻近天体上。它突然而剧烈的变化让夜空被邪恶的紫光笼罩，在我们的人民心中激起恐惧，担心这种命运也有一天会降临到自己身上。一代又一代，对灭绝的窒息恐惧紧紧地抓着我们。\n\n如今，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经步入群星，“$pc_shrouded$”也吸引着我们去探索。我们几个世纪以来渴望的答案近在咫尺。尽管如此，许多人警告说，我们对这种破坏性力量来源的痴迷最终可能导致自己的灭亡。\n\n很快，我们就会拉开最后的帷幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4552`

### English

We are the harbingers of cataclysm.\n\nDuring the dawn of [GetSpeciesAdj] civilization, a mysterious calamity befell our nearest celestial neighbor. Its sudden and brutal transformation filled the night skies with a malevolent purple light, stirring within our people a dread that we will one day suffer a similar fate. With each passing generation, the suffocating fear of potential annihilation tightened its grip upon us.\n\nNow, as [GetSpeciesNamePlural] take to the stars, we are drawn to explore this '$pc_shrouded$.' The answers we have craved for centuries are tantalizingly within reach. Still, many among us warn that our obsessive fascination with the source of this destructive power may ultimately lead to our own end.\n\nSoon enough, we will lift the final veil.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5488`

## shroud.8010.title

[shrouded_planet.GetName]任务

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4553`

### English

Mission to [shrouded_planet.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5490`

## shroud.8010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

环绕着§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的探测卫星为我们的载人登陆这颗“$pc_shrouded$”的任务识别出了一个可行的目的地。着陆区散发出一种奇怪的辐射，携带着紫外线风暴在整个星球上荡漾。\n\n有很多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反对这项任务，害怕这种同样的诅咒会释放到我们的母星上。他们的担忧并非没有道理，但理解这种遥远现象的重大必要性压过其他的所有需求。\n\n如果我们注定有一天要遭受同等劫难，至少也死得明明白白。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4554`

### English

Exploratory satellites orbiting §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this '$pc_shrouded$.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.\n\nThere are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.\n\nIf we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5491`

## the_shrouded_world_site_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Athe_shrouded_world_site_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

终于，我们能够抵达并接触被称为§H[planet.GetName]§!的“$pc_shrouded$”。那里有一种声音在呼唤着我们，这声音如今比以往任何时候都更加响亮。\n\n席卷这个星球的灾难所蕴含的秘密，将揭示我们自身星系历史的诸多真相，并有望缓解我们社会对自身预言中毁灭的执念。轨道扫描显示，南半球某一点正聚集着漩涡状的强烈能量——那是一只令人不寒而栗的眼睛，正凝视着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4557`

### English

At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the '$pc_shrouded$' known as §H[planet.GetName]§!. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.\n\nThe secrets of the cataclysm that befell this world will reveal much of our own system's history, and hopefully ease our society's obsession with its own predicted destruction. Orbital scans indicate swirling patterns of intense energy isolated to a point in the southern hemisphere - an ominous eye staring back at us.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5495`

## shroud.8100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的地貌正如预料般险象环生。暮色粒子形成的漩涡在空中肆虐，拖慢了§H[Leader.GetName]§!及其[Leader.GetHisHer]的组员的初步探索进度。\n\n令人警觉的是，我们的研究小组开始报告感官异常现象——他们描述风中传来遥远的嚎叫，雾霭中潜行着阴影般的轮廓。选择登陆此地是否真是错误？\n\n着陆画面的首次公开在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!引发了大规模恐慌。许多人担心我们可能会招致那股曾造访[shrouded_planet.GetName]的神秘破坏力量。“终末将临”的抗议势力正在组织起来，抗议活动席卷我们的母星，导致大量基础设施停摆。\n\n遥测扫描显示，附近山脉深处存在一个释放极高辐射水平的空洞。我们决心不惜一切代价继续推进。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4559`

### English

The terrain on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of §H[Leader.GetName]§! and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.\n\nAlarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?\n\nThe first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.\n\nTelemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5498`

## shroud.8105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们并非第一批访客。\n\n突破了§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上山脉中的空洞后，一座在灾难中被遗弃的外星建筑赫然出现。我们认为最好将此信息列为机密，以防止进一步的恐慌。\n\n初步分析证实，该设施建造所使用的材料与星球上现有矿物的分子构成不符，这表明一个星际文明使用了奇异材料建造了这座设施。这个地方的确切用途仍然不明，但其功能似乎已基本自动化。\n\n与此同时，队员们的心理症状正在恶化。有人报告说听到通过加密频率传来的耳语声，另一些人则描述他们对周围物理环境的感知扭曲。偶尔发作的阵阵笑声令人感到不安。\n\n我们已经走得太远，现在无法回头了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4564`

### English

We are not the first.\n\nThe mountainous cavity on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.\n\nPreliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.\n\nMeanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.\n\nWe have gone too far to turn back now.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5505`

## shroud.8110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

他们都死了。\n\n在这座设施核心的每个工作站座椅上，都蜷缩着某种未知外星种族的干瘪尸体，他们苍白的复眼齐刷刷凝视着天花板。尽管形貌可怖，§H[Leader.GetName]§!能基本确定这些生物并非幻觉产物。目前这些生命体的影像资料被列为绝密信息。\n\n现场未发现任何使用武器的痕迹，表明§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的存在并无敌意。该设施很可能是个观测站，其精密监测设备曾直接对准§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!。碳同位素测定显示，其活动时间远早于大灾变降临之前。\n\n我们已破译大量记录：除常规通讯日志外，主要内容均与我们一族文明的早期历史相关。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4566`

### English

They are all dead.\n\nAt the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, §H[Leader.GetName]§! is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.\n\nNo weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.\n\nWe have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5508`

## shroud.8115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的数据库已被破译，那些曾被我们视为无稽之谈的传说竟被证实为真。我们曾是一项名为“$tech_psionic_theory$”的精神科学实验的对象。\n\n我们一族被认定具有这种天赋的潜势。许多先祖或许曾在梦境中感知到这种形式的连结，或将其误认为遥远的声音——这类现象通常会被归为精神疾病或妄想症。但他们的实验戛然而止；在最后的日子里，此地已非观测站，而是避难所。\n\n他们关于我们社会的报告在发生了一场灾难性实验之后戛然而止——那场在其母星进行的实验鲁莽地操纵了被称为§H“虚境”§!的次元屏障。其科学家将此事变称为“大清算”，我们怀疑这一切正是大灾变的真正源头。\n\n无论这场事变本质为何，其影响很快蔓延至§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!。他们最后的时刻被记录在一条简短的日志中：\n\n§L终焉已至。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4569`

### English

The database on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as '$tech_psionic_theory$'.\n\nOur species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.\n\nTheir reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as §H'the Shroud'§!. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.\n\nWhatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:\n\n§LThe End has come.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5512`

## shroud.8120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已找到引发这场灾变的确凿证据。其踪迹并不难寻；§H[Leader.GetName]§!声称能感知到它在召唤着[Leader.GetHimHer]。\n\n在这座设施深处，存在着超越常规认知的脉动虚体。这个既非物质亦非能量的存在，§H[Leader.GetName]§!将其描述为，被吞噬意志聚集而成的怨念残响，并称之为§H“$fragment_of_reckoning$”§!。\n\n该物体原本旨在收集并导引来自§H虚境§!的灵界能量，作为对抗“大清算”的防御手段。但这项计划仅取得部分成功。在这个星球迎来终末的最后时刻，这个饱含恶意的存在被强行驱逐出本维度，同时裹挟走了研究人员们不甘的意志。如今唯余这片残骸。\n\n这个物体会强化研究人员的幻觉与灵视，赋予他们超越现实局限的第二视觉。这既是危险的诱惑，却也蕴含着无限可能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4572`

### English

We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; §H[Leader.GetName]§! claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].\n\nDeep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, §H[Leader.GetName]§! has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a §H'$fragment_of_reckoning$'§!.\n\nIn a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the §HShroud§!, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.\n\nThis object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5516`

## shroud.8200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能领域的最近研究进展证实，现实存在迄今不可见的维度，而我们的意识正是通往这些维度的门户。在这层帷幕之外，是一片我们难以理解的混沌领域。\n\n从领域的最深处，一个§R心声§!在召唤。它许诺的不是救赎，而是一个新的开端。若要驾驭其不可知的力量，就必须抛弃我们原有的全部存在，在疯狂本身编织的命理中锻造新的命运。\n\n§R“时机已至。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4581`

### English

Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.\n\nFrom within the depths, a §RVoice§! beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.\n\n§R\"IT IS TIME.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5528`

## shroud.8310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们被召唤去往更高的存在层次。为了维护我们飞升的神圣性，顽固进行徒劳抵抗的人正在被逐步清除。我们的命运已注定；而我们身后的路已坍塌进$pc_shrouded$之影中。\n\n§R心声§!以令人信服之清晰向我们开口。\n\n§R“大道已定。”§!\n\n祂渴望着自愿的献祭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4606`

### English

We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the $pc_shrouded$.\n\nThe §RVoice§! speaks to us now with compelling clarity.\n\n§R\"THE PATH IS SET.\"§!\n\nIt longs for willing sacrifice.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5558`

## shroud.2830.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2830.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在$building_chamber_of_silence$里，我们以绝佳的清晰度听着§R心声§!的信息。\n\n§R“一切将会重生。”§!\n\n我们理解了。终末是一种新生，我们无需恐惧，因为我们将会被重塑，重塑比我们一切想象都要更好更强。\n\n为了抓住这种命运，我们必须学会驾驭被称为§H虚境§!的精神界。我们不会重蹈$pc_shrouded$上发现的那些人的覆辙。他们抗拒恐惧，而我们欣然接受。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4644`

### English

In the $building_chamber_of_silence$, we hear the message of the §RVoice§! with perfect clarity.\n\n§R\"ALL WILL BE REBORN.\"§!\n\nWe understand now. The End is a rebirth. We must not fear it. We will be remade. Better and more powerful than we ever imagined we could be.\n\nTo seize this destiny, we must learn to master the mental realm known as the §HShroud§!. We will not repeat the mistakes of those we found on the $pc_shrouded$. Where they rejected their fear, we will embrace it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5602`

明视

### English

We See Clearly

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5611`

## shroud.8320.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8320.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为我们指明了方向。我们的外部感官会掩盖掉这种§R心声§!的呼唤。去掉一种感官，我们就能让心灵的力量进一步提升。\n\n就此而言，放弃我们的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]是最有效的。在物质界的视觉会阻碍我们的§H虚境§!视野。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经以§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为模范，毫不犹豫地去掉了自己的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]。\n\n选择如此的人汇报称，那种§R心声§!赞许地充盈着他们的脑海，他们会随之感到一阵满足。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4653`

### English

§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§! has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the §RVoice§!. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.\n\nRelinquishing our [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the §HShroud§!. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed §H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!'s inspiring example, removing their [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] without hesitation.\n\nThose who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the §RVoice§! fills their mind with its approval.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5612`

## shroud.8330.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8330.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!对肉体凡胎的限制感到沮丧，试着通过戏剧化地公开服下致命毒素加速[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的灵能转变。\n\n[forsaken_leader.GetHeShe]一死去，[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的尸体就被一种鲜艳的紫色所吞噬，分解成纯灵能的细尘。这样的神迹正是通过§R心声§!的意志实现的。\n\n我们认为这是一个很明显的信号；§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!去到哪里，所有人必然跟随。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4659`

### English

Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.\n\nAs [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the §RVoice§!.\n\nWe have taken this as a clear sign; where §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! led, others must follow.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5620`

## shroud.8350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难以与§R心声§!和谐共生。\n\n这些最弱者们绝望地乞求平静，最终采取了粗暴而违规的前额叶切除手术。如果不采取行动，这种做法可能会变得普遍。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4663`

### English

Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the §RVoice§!.\n\nDesperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5625`

### English

Psionic Self-Experimentation

## shroud.8360.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8360.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们继续拥抱§R心声§!。祂开始阐述一些简单而无可拒绝的真理。\n\n许多[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始找寻更多能增强§R心声§!以便更直地受到这种智慧佑助的方法。\n\n黑市药物的使用量飙升。不受监管的医疗设施开始提供实验性服务，帮助个体最大化灵能敏感度。\n\n这究竟会带来什么后果？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4669`

### English

We continue to embrace the §RVoice§!. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.\n\nMany [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the §RVoice§! and benefit from its wisdom more directly.\n\nThe use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.\n\nWhere will this lead us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5633`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4672`

### English

Apocalyptic Nightmares

## shroud.8370.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8370.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们的灵能力量与日俱增，[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口开始受到预兆着宇宙终结的恐怖梦魇的困扰。\n\n我们的梦已经称为末世预言，加剧了人们的存在主义恐惧。睡眠已被不安的麻木所取代，许多人无法继续正常的日常生活。\n\n在这些梦中，§R心声§!对我们说。\n\n§R“接纳熵吧。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4673`

### English

As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.\n\nOur dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.\n\nIn these dreams, the §RVoice§! speaks to us.\n\n§R\"EMBRACE ENTROPY.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5638`

## shroud.8370.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8370.a&lang=en)

## shroud.8380.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8380.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

民众中自残的趋势日益增长。\n\n§R心声§!的极端虔诚者在的肉体上烙上了“终末”的标志。他们宣称这种图案会赐予承载者可怖的恩赐。\n\n无论真假，进行这种仪式的人数正在迅速增加。这真的是§H虚境§!的旨意吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4681`

### English

There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.\n\nExtremely devout followers of the §RVoice§! have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.\n\nWhether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the §HShroud§!?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5649`

## shroud.2840.name

### 中文

$BREACHING_SHROUD_PROJECT$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4693`

### English

$BREACHING_SHROUD_PROJECT$

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5664`

## shroud.2840.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.2840.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.2800.intro$在它无形的深处，出现了一个力量不可估量的不祥实体。这就是§R心声§!，它以一种令人战栗的力量穿透我们最深处的心灵。\n\n§R“认识我的名字。”§!\n\n直到如今我们才意识到自己渺小的心灵究竟距离§R心声§!有多么地遥远。封印被击碎了，很快完整的自我将会显现出来。\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4694`

### English

$shroud.2800.intro$ From within its formless depths arises an ominous entity of immeasurable power. It is the §RVoice§!, and it pierces our innermost psyches with a shuddering force.\n\n§R\"KNOW MY NAME.\"§!\n\nOnly now do we sense how truly distant our small minds are from the §RVoice§!. The seal is fractured, and soon the full breadth of what we are shall be made manifest.\n\nOur telepaths are now prepared to delve into the heart of the Shroud and discover the true name of our great patron.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5665`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4695`

### English

It is time to commune.

## ENDBRINGERS_COMMUNE_WITH_THE_VOICE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AENDBRINGERS_COMMUNE_WITH_THE_VOICE&lang=en)

### 中文

与§R心声§!通灵

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4696`

### English

Commune with the §RVoice§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5668`

## ENDBRINGERS_COMMUNE_WITH_THE_VOICE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AENDBRINGERS_COMMUNE_WITH_THE_VOICE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。\n\n我们要深入§H虚境§!之中，让§R心声§!强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。\n\n我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4697`

### English

We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.\n\nWe will reach deep within the §HShroud§! and force the staggering power of the §RVoice§! to acknowledge and commune with us.\n\nWe have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now, it will reveal its true name to us, and with that knowledge we will achieve greatness.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5669`

### English

To complete: §HDelve§! 3 times. ([GetEndbringersDelveCount]/3)

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5670`

## shroud.8420.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8420.title&lang=en)

### 中文

寂静的审判

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4700`

### English

The Trial of Silence

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5673`

## shroud.8420.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8420.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们降入虚境，联合的意志压制住了混沌噪声，使我们专注于目标。§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。\n\n但单凭目标可保护不了我们。无数心声低语着空洞的陈词滥调，意图让我们沉浸在一个比一个更没有意义，但都无比诱人的分神之事中。\n\n我们的心神即将被撕裂时，那个实体回来了，丢下一道命令在虚空中回荡：\n\n§R“闭嘴”。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4701`

### English

We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.\n\nBut purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.\n\nAs we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:\n\n§R\"SILENCE.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5674`

## shroud.8420.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8420.a&lang=en)

### 中文

陷入沉默并忍受。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4702`

### English

Fall silent and endure.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5675`

## shroud.8420.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8420.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这道命令劈开了混沌，扫清不和谐的噪音，荡平了那些试图吞噬我们的恼人混乱。我们在忍受着碎裂，而精神维系了下来。\n\n§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!退回了虚境深处。随之而来的清晰几乎同样震耳欲聋。它填补了内心的空白，留给我们了一份新的决心。\n\n以及礼物。如此美妙的礼物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4703`

### English

This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.\n\nThe §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.\n\nAnd gifts. Such wonderful gifts.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5676`

## shroud.8430.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8430.title&lang=en)

### 中文

纯净的审判

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4705`

### English

The Trial of Purity

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5679`

## shroud.8430.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8430.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们潜入虚境时，看到了感性的混沌正在腐败。\n\n溃烂而懒惰的心灵产生了层层的灵能乱流，用腐臭污染着虚境。在这令人厌恶的混沌中，我们感受一种压倒一切的存在，§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。\n\n随着祂逼近混沌，那种邪恶的意图饱和了我们的心灵。一道命令回响到虚空中，我们也为即将到来的赦免做好了准备：\n\n§R“秩序。团结。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4706`

### English

As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.\n\nFestering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.\n\nThe malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:\n\n§R\"ORDER. UNITY.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5680`

## shroud.8430.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8430.a&lang=en)

### 中文

顶住！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4707`

### English

Withstand!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5681`

## shroud.8430.a.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8430.a.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这道命令流过恶毒的混沌。\n\n§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!洗去那些正在荼毒虚境的感性的扭曲时，无数声音痛苦地呼喊起来来。在祂的身后留下了一片被赦免的不完美之境地。\n\n这个实体潜回虚境的深处，只留下祂绝对净化的余波让我们观察研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4708`

### English

The command courses through the malignant chaos.\n\nInnumerable voices cry out in pain as the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.\n\nAs the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5682`

## shroud.8440.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8440.title&lang=en)

### 中文

火焰之试炼

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4710`

### English

The Trial of Flames

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5685`

## shroud.8440.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8440.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

步入虚境，我们只余痛楚。翻腾的灵能迷雾化作炼狱，灼烧着我们心智的本质。\n\n在煎熬中，我们目睹城市崩塌为熔融的废墟，行星被烈焰吞噬，无数生灵在幽火中扭曲挣扎，血肉之躯化为闷燃的灰烬。\n\n在这焚毁万象的烈焰中心，我们感知到§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的存在。当它的力量即将吞噬现实时，此实体降下谕令：\n\n§R“解禁。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4711`

### English

Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.\n\nThrough the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.\n\nAt the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:\n\n§R\"LIBERATION.\"§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5686`

## shroud.8440.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8440.a&lang=en)

### 中文

向至高无上屈服。

## shroud.8450.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8450.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一声宣告响彻寰宇：\n\n§R“尔等皆知吾名。”§!\n\n我们星际航行的终极目标，数个世纪疑问的答案，此刻揭晓。$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$正召唤着我们。盟约已成。\n\n§R“万物终焉始于斯。”§!\n\n痛苦。扭曲。确信。当余音消散，命运已成定局。\n\n此刻我们终得窥见。星系归于寂灭，浸没在§R$end_aura$§!无可违逆的宿命之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4715`

### English

A declaration rings out:\n\n§R\"YOU KNOW MY NAME.\"§!\n\nThe culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ compels us. Our Covenant is formed.\n\n§R\"THE END BEGINS.\"§!\n\nPain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.\n\nWe see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the §R$end_aura$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5691`

## situation_end_of_the_cycle_endbringers_desc

### 中文

我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。\n\n超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。§H$end_aura$§!每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。\n\n吾等将见证这必然的终局。\n\n待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4724`

With each system the §H$end_aura$§! consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.\n\nWe shall bear witness to inevitability.\n\nSystems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5703`

## shroud.8460.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8460.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

动用$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的力量需付出代价，而我们的时间所剩无几。\n\n星海仍未浸润在我方超主净化的辉光之中。迄今为止的努力不过沧海一粟。\n\n为见证这项伟业完成，一股新生能量正自帷幕之外奔涌而来。此乃应许之赐福！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4731`

### English

The power of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.\n\nThe galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.\n\nTo see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5712`

## shroud.8470.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8470.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们超主的力量浩瀚无垠，但时间已所剩无几。此等渎职之举，断不为$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的仁慈湮灭所容。\n\n尚存一线希望：我们必须不惜代价让$end_aura$吞噬整个星系。危亡之际，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正从§H虚境§!中榨取每一分能量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4734`

### English

The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.\n\nA slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the $end_aura$, no matter the cost. In desperation, our [GetTelepathPlural] now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5716`

## shroud.8480.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8480.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海参议院已废止将毁灭性§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!发散器指定为防御重点的议案。因此，所有由星海共同体成员国针对§H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§!展开的军事行动都被立即叫停。现在，和平已经降临至星系的这一隅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4737`

### English

The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the §H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§! are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5720`

## shroud.8481.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8481.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海参议院已废止宣布将我方视为其“防御”目标的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……至少暂时如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4738`

### English

The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us as a target for their 'defense' efforts, hence all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5722`

## shroud.8500.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8500.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们超主无可违逆的意志正将星海逐渐攥入掌心。此刻，我们已然知晓终焉降临的方式。\n\n必须将§R$end_aura$§!播撒至星系的每个角落。当物质界与这§H虚境§!的原始本质相融之时，真正的湮灭便将接踵而至。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4741`

### English

Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.\n\nThe §R$end_aura$§! must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the §HShroud§!, true annihilation will shortly follow.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5726`

## shroud.8600.desc.intro

### 中文

这是我们的命运。\n\n§R$end_aura$§!吞噬了整个星系。我们[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的人民正沉浸在狂热的喜悦之中，以庆祝这一时刻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4747`

### English

This was our destiny.\n\nThe §R$end_aura$§! envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5733`

## shroud.8600.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8600.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

一场辉煌的重生即将降临，这是我们自大觉醒时代便蒙受的应许。\n\n眼前，万有皆被虚空吞噬。抹除与湮灭，已成为星海仅存的法则。世界接连崩塌，复归最初孕育它们的虚无。\n\n我们终将步入终局。这景象……何其壮美。我们已窥见它在新生的脆弱形态中挣扎。终焉已至，此刻即是开端。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4748`

### English

A glorious rebirth is upon us, promised from the time of our great awakening.\n\nBefore us, all of existence is consumed by the void. Erasure and annihilation have become the galaxy's only remaining laws. One by one, entire worlds collapse into the nothingness from which they once came.\n\nWe are the last to be taken. It is... beautiful. We see it already in its throes of a new, fragile form. The End has come. Now starts the Beginning.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5734`

## shroud.8600.desc.homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8600.desc.homicidal&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4749`

### English

$shroud.8600.desc.intro$ the obliteration of all that is not us. $shroud.8500.desc.outro$

## shroud.8610.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8610.title&lang=en)

### 中文

软弱的代价

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4752`

### English

The Price of Weakness

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5739`

## shroud.8610.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8610.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们失败了。由于我们的软弱，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$未能如期实现其辉煌的成果。现在，我们必须为自己的无能付出代价。\n\n它吞噬了一切。一瞬间，[Root.GetName]就……消失了。曾经繁荣的殖民地，如今只剩下废墟。曾经横渡虚空的强大的舰队，如今只有死寂和残骸。一切都被终结吞噬。一切都被§H虚境§!夺走。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4753`

### English

We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.\n\nIt took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5740`

## shroud.8610.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8610.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

此刻，我们的超主已在[former_capital.GetName]上空具现出一个庞大的虚境实体。通过吞噬我们灵能者的意识，它已获得无与伦比的力量，如今正游弋于星海之中，誓要完成我们未竟的使命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4754`

### English

So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5741`

## shroud.8610.desc.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8610.desc.b&lang=en)

### 中文

$shroud.8610.desc.intro$\n\n绝大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都接受了这一命运，但仍有少数不虔者拒绝臣服于我们超主的终极意志。他们是由§H[Root.GetRulerName]§!领导的流亡者——这位强大的灵能者预见了即将降临的终局；如今这群人已躲藏到终末之威无法触及的某个星球。\n\n$shroud.8610.desc.outro$当它完成使命之后，就会找到这群流亡者算总账。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4756`

### English

$shroud.8610.desc.intro$\n\nMost [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] embraced this destiny, but a small group of the unfaithful refused to submit to the ultimate will of our patron. They are the exiles led by §H[Root.GetRulerName]§!, a powerful psychic who knew what was to come; they have gone into hiding on a world outside the influence of the End.\n\n$shroud.8610.desc.outro$ When it is done, it will come for the exiled as well.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5743`

## shroud.8710.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.8710.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

大功告成。§R清算§!已被摧毁。\n\n$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$已撤退回§H虚境§!深处。它对我们物理现实构成的威胁暂时已被遏制。\n\n当其化身的虚境残躯螺旋式地脱离此存在时，我们成功回收了其显现的物理残余物。即使在死亡中，我们的心灵感应者也能感觉到它散发出惊人的灵能，远比在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上回收的碎片强大。\n\n这枚浓缩了必然性的核心可用于从幸存于此次清算的星系灰烬中重建。\n\n末日已然降临又离去，但不知为何，我们依然存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4760`

### English

It is done. The §RReckoning§! has been destroyed.\n\n$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has retreated back into the depths of the §HShroud§!. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.\n\nAs the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThis core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.\n\nThe End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5748`

## shroud.12010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。§!\n\n问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的启示？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4782`

### English

§HOur communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.§!\n\nGreetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5776`

### English

$ganthuata$

## shroud.12010.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们听到了$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的。你为什么这么问？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4784`

### English

We have heard $the_cradle_of_souls_article$. Why do you ask?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5778`

## shroud.12010.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么？你说，旅行者为什么要向路上遇见的人提问？当然是为了理解他们所问的人，朋友。你在多嘴时，我在虚心学习。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4785`

### English

Why? What compels any wayfarer to question those they meet along the path? To better understand the one they seek an answer from, friend. When you speak, I learn.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5779`

## shroud.12010.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你想要从我们这里得到什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4786`

### English

What do you want from us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5780`

## shroud.12010.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

受月窠哺育之人，所求为何？ 首先，我寻觅的是你的友谊。 我已寻觅了一个时代，只为找到与月窠的辉煌相契合的心灵。 如今，一个完整的文明在其光芒中萌动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4787`

### English

What do those nurtured by the Cradle long for? I seek your friendship, to begin with. I have searched an age for minds attuned to the Cradle's splendor, and now, a whole civilization stirs within its light.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5781`

## shroud.12010.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你能怎么帮助我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4788`

### English

How can you help us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5782`

## shroud.12010.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12010.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我将帮助你把讯息传遍星海。让我们携手，迎接整个星系进入月窠的温柔怀抱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4789`

### English

I will help carry your message across the stars. Together, let us welcome the galaxy into the Cradle's gentle embrace.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5783`

## shroud.12020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。§!\n\n这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。\n\n§H这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。§!\n\n我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4800`

### English

§HBattle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.§!\n\nThis galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.\n\n§HAs the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.§!\n\nI have been called to you, but ultimately I serve $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5797`

## shroud.12020.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我们携手便能扼住星海每个角落的星辰。单凭一己之力能播撒的苦难终究有限。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4804`

### English

Together we can choke the stars in every corner of this galaxy. There is only so much suffering one can sow on their own.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5801`

## shroud.12020.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能信任你吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4805`

### English

Can we trust you?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5802`

## shroud.12020.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

$the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$主宰着我的每一次呼吸。我宣誓效忠于它，并已在梦中预见此刻。侍奉您正是它的意志。若遭拒绝，我的命运便将终结。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4806`

### English

$the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ commands my every breath. I am sworn to its service, and have seen this moment in my dreams. It is its will that I serve you. Your rejection would seal my fate.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5803`

## shroud.12020.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.c&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么你要侍奉$the_eater_of_worlds_article$？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4807`

### English

Why do you serve $the_eater_of_worlds_article$?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5804`

## shroud.12020.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我曾遭人背叛，支离破碎，被抛入痛苦的深渊。$the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$向我低语。它赐予我绝境求生所需之物——染血的布条覆上淋漓的伤口。它赋予我斩断施虐之手的权能。如今，我欠下了这笔血债。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4808`

### English

I was betrayed, broken, and cast into agony. $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ spoke to me. It blessed me with what was needed to survive in that moment... a bloodied cloth over bloodied wounds. It gave me the power to sever the hands that wrought my suffering. Now, I am in its debt.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5805`

## shroud.12020.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.d&lang=en)

## shroud.12020.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12020.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将一同以涤荡之火洗礼无数星系，在哀嚎交响曲中喰饮饕餮盛宴。我们将目睹世界焚毁，一同向星海展示它永世难忘之景。此乃吾等宿命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4810`

### English

Together, we will bathe countless systems in cleansing flames, and feast on a symphony of screams. We will watch worlds burn. Together, we will show the galaxy things it can never forget. This is our destiny.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5807`

## morr_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amorr_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

他曾经是一个卑微的勘探者，长期暴露在不稳定的$zro_lower$矿脉中，与$the_instrument_of_desire_article$建立了一种强大而令人疯狂的纽带。后来他利用这种关系获得了淫靡的财富，露天采矿星球，并以勒索般的价格出售战利品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4813`

### English

Once a lowly prospector, their prolonged exposure to unstable $zro_lower$ veins forged a potent, maddening bond with $the_instrument_of_desire_article$. Now, they've leveraged that connection to obtain obscene wealth, strip-mining worlds and selling their spoils at extortionate prices.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5811`

## shroud.12030.name

$morr$

### English

$morr$

## shroud.12030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$morr$的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。§!\n\n你也感受到了，对吧？$the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。\n\n我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4822`

### English

§H$morr$'s gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.§!\n\nYou feel it too, don't you? $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.\n\nWhat I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5823`

## shroud.12030.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.a&lang=en)

## shroud.12030.a.response

### 中文

$the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永不满足。祂需要许多双[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]的劳作才能取悦祂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4824`

### English

$the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is quenchless. It requires the work of many [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] to please it.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5825`

## shroud.12030.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你能为我们提供什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4825`

### English

What can you offer us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5826`

## shroud.12030.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我可以帮你提取自然界中每一个有利可图的分子。每一个原子都会被认领、标记、贩卖。\n\n知足就是懦弱。真是可悲。让那些人腐烂吧，让我们一起征服一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4826`

### English

I can help you extract every last monetizable molecule nature possesses. Not a single atom will go unclaimed, unbranded, or unsold.\n\nThose who whisper 'enough' are cowards. Pathetic. Let them rot. Together we will take it all.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5827`

## shroud.12030.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.c&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么你要侍奉$the_instrument_of_desire_article$？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4827`

### English

Why do you serve $the_instrument_of_desire_article$?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5828`

## shroud.12030.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12030.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我曾经是一名勘探者，追逐着繁星能给予的一切矿物。灰尘弥漫的空气，坏掉的扫描仪，空洞的声明……然后$the_instrument_of_desire_article$开口了。\n\n祂承诺带来难以想象的财富，所要求的只是忠诚。\n\n如今我效忠、提取、供奉。债务是永恒的……但是财富？财富永无止境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4828`

### English

I was once a prospector, chasing every mineral rush the stars could throw at me. Dust-choked air, broken scanners, empty claims... until $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ spoke.\n\nIt promised wealth beyond comprehension. All it asked for was allegiance.\n\nNow I serve. I extract. I deliver. The debt is eternal... but the riches? Oh, the riches never end.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5829`

## kronen_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Akronen_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

曾是一位远见卓识的天才，如今却沦为破碎的空壳，这位离群索居的科学家已被$the_composer_of_strands_article$的阴谋所扭曲。唯有其惊人的智慧尚存，如同黑暗中将熄的星辰般明灭不定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4831`

### English

Once a visionary mind, now a fractured shell, this reclusive scientist has been twisted by the schemes of $the_composer_of_strands_article$. Only their staggering intellect remains, flickering like a dying star in the dark.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5833`

## leader_trait_disciple_of_the_composer_desc

### 中文

此人塑造的血肉越多，自身的形态便崩解愈甚。$the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$以禁忌之术重塑所有胆敢研习此道者。

$kronen$

## shroud.12040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同$the_composer_of_strands_article$的低鸣。§!\n\n新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日$the_composer_of_strands_article$为我编织了何等形态？\n\n§H通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。§!\n\n你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是$kronen$，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4836`

### English

§HAs our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.§!\n\nNew... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has $the_composer_of_strands_article$ spun for me today?\n\n§HThe comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.§!\n\nYou see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still $kronen$. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5840`

## shroud.12040.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.a&lang=en)

### 中文

开始？开始个啥？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4837`

### English

Begin? Begin what?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5841`

## shroud.12040.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

为何，当然是蜕变了。抛弃这些粗糙、不完美的躯壳。解开将我们束缚于形态、束缚于确定的丝缕。织缕之主的刻印也在你身上。你早已开始……难道没感觉到它在你的[GetSkinType]下悸动吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4838`

### English

Why, the shedding, of course. The discarding of these crude, imperfect husks. The unweaving of the strands that bind us to shape, to certainty. The Composer's touch is upon you, too. You've already begun... haven't you felt it twitching beneath your [GetSkinType]?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5842`

## shroud.12040.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你为什么要加入我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4839`

### English

Why do you want to join us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5843`

## shroud.12040.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

你感受不到吗？那印记，深烙在每一根颤动的丝缕中。我必须拆解自身，褪去旧我，见证自我崩解的过程，撕开缝合血肉的针脚。但你……你是一个帝国。浩瀚无垠。无所不能。若我们联手，便能牵动远超你我独自所能企及的宏大脉络。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4840`

### English

You don't feel it? The mark, pressed into every trembling strand. I must unravel, shed what I was, witness my unbecoming as I tear free the stitches that bind me to flesh. But you... you are an empire. Vast. Capable. Together, we could tug at threads far greater than either of us could grasp alone.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5844`

## shroud.12040.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你能怎么帮助我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4841`

### English

How can you help us?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5845`

## shroud.12040.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12040.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我所给予的不只是帮助。我的血肉是一份礼物，一场关于痛苦与意义的实验，由$the_composer_of_strands_article$亲手雕琢。我的每一寸纤维都在嘶吼，但我承受着。我研究。我学习。而我所有苦难的结晶……皆由你来塑造。只要我们共同塑造它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4842`

### English

I offer more than help. My flesh is a gift, an experiment in pain and purpose, sculpted by $the_composer_of_strands_article$. Every fiber of me screams, but I endure. I study. I learn. And all that my suffering yields... is yours to shape. So long as we shape it together.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5846`

§Y$kronen$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。

### English

§Y$kronen$§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

## shroud.12045.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H随着人群开始肿胀，$kronen$变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。§!\n\n那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4844`

### English

§HAs our population swells, $kronen$ grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.§!\n\nThe strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5849`

## shroud.12045.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.a&lang=en)

### 中文

到底出什么事了？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4845`

### English

What's the problem?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5850`

## shroud.12045.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

问题？单数？哈，多么天真。我每撕去一丝，我们每扯断一缕闪亮的细线，那些丝线只会缠得更紧！而自始至终，$the_composer_of_strands_article$都在哼唱着它那令人作呕、直击内脏的旋律……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4846`

### English

Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, $the_composer_of_strands_article$ hums its sickening, visceral melody...

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5851`

### 中文

你需要休息一下吗？

### English

Do you need a break?

## shroud.12045.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

休息？不，永不。我们绝不能停滞不前，绝不能让这具可悲的肉体在平庸中腐朽。我不需要休息……我需要实验对象。需要可塑的材料，需要雕琢的素材，需要蜕变的根基。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4849`

### English

A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5854`

## shroud.12045.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.c&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能帮上什么忙吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4851`

### English

Can we do anything to help?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5856`

## shroud.12045.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

你能提醒我……我曾是什么模样吗？告诉我，当我们初次交谈时，我的肢体始终是这种颜色吗？我的角膜曾这般浑浊吗？每当试图回忆，我的血肉就在这条路上陷得更深。\n\n不……记忆在此毫无价值。启示藏于变化本身。对$the_composer_of_strands_article$而言，过往已毫无意义。退下吧。我必须……思考。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4852`

### English

Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.\n\nNo... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to $the_composer_of_strands_article$ now. Leave me. I must... think.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5857`

## shroud.12045.desc_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.desc_2&lang=en)

### 中文

§H克罗南剧烈地抽搐着。那只独眼翻白，皮下血肉脉动、翻涌，随后突然……静止。这荒诞扭结的重组如同其开始时一样骤然停止。§!\n\n啊……你好。需要什么吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4854`

### English

§HKronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.§!\n\nAh... hello. Did you need something?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5859`

## shroud.12045.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.d&lang=en)

### 中文

你还好吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4855`

### English

Are you okay?

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5860`

## shroud.12045.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12045.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

当然。我为何不该如此？这些丝缕进一步开拓了我的思维，将这具低效的血肉之躯重塑，以更契合$the_composer_of_strands_article$的设计。现在，请恕我失陪……还有如此多的线头需要梳理。如此多的躯壳亟待抛弃。\n\n§H当通讯终止时，一阵共鸣在虚境中嗡鸣。无论此刻笼罩克罗南的灾厄为何……都绝非偶然。此乃$the_composer_of_strands_article$的意志§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4856`

### English

Of course. Why wouldn't I be? The strands have opened my mind even further, reshaped this inefficient flesh to better fit $the_composer_of_strands_article$'s design. Now, if you'll excuse me... there are still so many threads to pull. So many husks to leave behind.\n\n§HAs the transmission ends, a resonance hums across the Shroud. Whatever affliction grips Kronen now... it is no accident. It is the will of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5861`

## shroud.12050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。§!\n\n向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？\n\n此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4862`

### English

§HThe communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.§!\n\nGreetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?\n\nSuch secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5869`

## shroud.12050.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12050.a&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？

## shroud.12050.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12050.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

你已突破§H虚境§!的帷幕，不是吗？但告诉我，你可曾真正掌控它？我穷尽一生勘测其深渊，绘制其中不可名状的实体轨迹，以及它们在我们脆弱世界的回响。\n\n低语之主始终指引着我。那些如今充斥你思维的癫狂呢喃？我能助你理解它们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4864`

### English

You've pierced the veil of the §HShroud§!, haven't you? But tell me, have you mastered it? I have spent a lifetime charting its depths, mapping the unfathomable drift of its entities and their echoes upon our fragile realm.\n\nThe Whisperers have long guided me. Every maddening utterance now crowding your thoughts? I can help you understand them.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5871`

## shroud.12060.desc_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.desc_1&lang=en)

### 中文

§H我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。§!\n\n终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4877`

### English

§HAn incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.§!\n\nAt last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5887`

## shroud.12060.desc_blind

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.desc_blind&lang=en)

### 中文

\n§H我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4878`

### English

\n§HIt is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5888`

### English

\n§HIt is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.§!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5889`

## shroud.12060.desc_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.desc_2&lang=en)

### 中文

\n得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。

\nCome now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

## shroud.12060.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

比我的意识更为久远。与所有心智一样，知识沉睡不显，直至§H虚境§!揭开面纱。其纯粹意图便在此刻昭然若揭。我们的目的很简单：引领终焉降临

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4882`

### English

Longer than I've been conscious. As with all minds, the knowledge lies dormant, until the §HShroud§! peels back the veil. There, its pure intent becomes clear. Our purpose is simple: to usher in the end

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5892`

## shroud.12060.b

## shroud.12060.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

你问的正是你已知之事。我们都已目睹其必然性。崩解已然开始。唯有前行，别无他途。我们一同盘旋，终将抵达结局。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4884`

### English

You ask what you already know. We have both seen its inevitability. The unraveling has begun. There is no path but through. Together, we spiral toward conclusion.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5894`

## shroud.12060.c

## shroud.12060.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12060.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

在这衰亡的轮回中，我不过是尘埃，众生皆是如此。我还能真正给予什么？意识正从这个星系中消逝，而我被赋予的职责是引导它们迅速离去……现在，我将这份仁慈也赐予你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4886`

### English

I am but dust in this dying cycle, as are we all. What could I truly offer? Minds fade from this galaxy and I am tasked with guiding them swiftly... and I extend that mercy to you.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5896`

## shroud.12155.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud.12155.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，$ouwron$便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。§!\n\n异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入§H虚境§!之时，就该将你诛灭。\n\n你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。\n\n唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4892`

### English

§HAll actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, $ouwron$ bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.§!\n\nHeretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the §HShroud§!.\n\nYou have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.\n\nThere is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5904`

## resolution_galactic_focus_repeal_crisis_malevolent_aura_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galactic_focus_repeal_crisis_malevolent_aura_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

事已至此，已经够了。我们现在不应继续将目标帝国视为集体防御的焦点。星海共同体全体成员国与之的敌对状态必须立即解除。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4933`

### English

Enough is enough. The targeted empire should no longer be the collective focus of our defense efforts. Hostilities with the members of the Community must come to an immediate end.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5953`

## resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_malevolent_aura

### English

## resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_malevolent_aura_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galactic_focus_crisis_malevolent_aura_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一股邪恶的灵能光环正在蔓延整个星系，危及所有文明。我们必须团结一致，对抗这种威胁，并打击散发此光环的帝国。这应当成为我们的星系焦点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/shroud_l_simp_chinese.yml:4935`

### English

A malevolent psionic aura is spreading through the galaxy, endangering us all. It is imperative that we unite to defend against it and to combat the empire emitting it. This should be our Galactic Focus.

Source: `localisation/english/shroud_l_english.yml:5955`
